paragraphs.en: Sandman: Building and Operating Sandboxes for Agentic Reinforcement Learning on Shared Kubernetes
paragraphs.zh: Sandman：在共享 Kubernetes 上构建和运营用于智能体强化学习的沙箱

paragraphs.en: Yiming Yan * Hongyang Wang * Wenbo Chen Xuan Wang Jingguo Liu Xian Li Chen Qi Leo Fan Siwei Li Qianli Wu Yichuan Li Ruochen Wen Qian Qu Zheshen Wang Benoit Dumoulin
paragraphs.zh: 姚一鸣 * 王洪阳 陈文博 王轩 刘景国 李显 齐晨 樊乐 李思伟 吴千里 李一川 温若晨 屈钱 王泽深 Benoit Dumoulin

paragraphs.en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) often requires repeated tool calls in task-specific environments. A training job may create thousands of these environments in bursts while sharing a cluster with other jobs. We present Sandman, a sandbox service built and operated at Amazon for agent tool execution and evaluation. It serves multiple production agentic RL workloads on shared Kubernetes. A training framework supplies a task image and uses commands and file operations in the returned sandbox. Files and processes persist across calls until the framework releases the environment. Sandman manages creation, readiness and cleanup. Each sandbox is a Kubernetes pod with a small daemon mounted into the unmodified image. In a scale test, Sandman held 11,858 concurrent tiny sandboxes. Four production SWE-bench Verified training campaigns created 3.1 million sandboxes in October 2026. We report the design trade-offs and operational lessons from handling creation bursts, preparing task environments, reclaiming abandoned sandboxes, and running evaluation under controlled conditions. We will open-source Sandman’s daemon, provider and pool.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体化强化学习（RL）通常需要在特定任务环境中反复调用工具。 一个训练作业可能会突发性地创建数千个此类环境，同时与其他作业共享一个集群。 我们介绍 Sandman，这是 Amazon 构建并运营的沙箱服务，用于智能体工具执行与评估。 它在共享的 Kubernetes 上为多个生产级智能体化 RL 工作负载提供服务。 训练框架提供一个任务镜像，并使用返回的沙箱中的命令与文件操作。 文件与进程会跨调用持续保留，直到框架释放该环境。 Sandman 负责创建、就绪检查与清理。 每个沙箱是一个 Kubernetes pod，其中挂载了一个小型守护进程到未经修改的镜像中。 在一次规模测试中，Sandman 维持了 11,858 个并发的微型沙箱。 2026 年 10 月，四个生产级 SWE-bench Verified 训练战役共创建了 310 万个沙箱。 我们报告了在应对创建突发、准备任务环境、回收被弃置的沙箱以及在受控条件下运行评估等方面的设计权衡与运维经验。 我们将开源 Sandman 的守护进程、提供程序与资源池。

paragraphs.en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains agents through repeated interactions with task environments. Tools run commands and file operations in sandboxes whose state persists across calls. Training jobs acquire these environments for rollouts and evaluation, then release them when finished.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体强化学习（RL）通过智能体与任务环境的反复交互来训练智能体。 工具在沙箱中运行命令和文件操作，沙箱的状态在多次调用之间保持持久。 训练任务会获取这些环境用于推演和评估，完成后将其释放。

sents.en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains agents through repeated interactions with task environments.
sents.zh: 智能体强化学习（RL）通过智能体与任务环境的反复交互来训练智能体。

sents.en: Tools run commands and file operations in sandboxes whose state persists across calls.
sents.zh: 工具在沙箱中运行命令和文件操作，沙箱的状态在多次调用之间保持持久。

sents.en: Training jobs acquire these environments for rollouts and evaluation, then release them when finished.
sents.zh: 训练任务会获取这些环境用于推演和评估，完成后将其释放。

paragraphs.en: Sandbox demand is large and bursty: in our software-engineering (SWE) campaigns, a training run starts dozens of rollouts within a second, and many runs share the cluster (Figure 1 a). We first ran Python and math rollouts on a managed code-interpreter service. It could not run task images, which ruled out SWE tasks, and when a batch of rollouts recycled its sessions together, throttled calls timed out trajectories (§ 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 沙盒需求庞大且呈突发性：在我们的软件工程（SWE）战役中，一次训练运行会在一秒内启动数十个 rollout，且许多运行共享同一集群（图 1 a）。 我们最初在托管的代码解释器服务上运行 Python 和数学类 rollout。 该服务无法运行任务镜像，这排除了 SWE 任务；而且当一批 rollout 同时回收其会话时，被限流的调用会导致轨迹超时（§ 4.1）。

paragraphs.en: We present Sandman, the sandbox service our team built and operates on a shared Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) cluster (Figure 2 ). It serves multiple production agentic RL workloads. A training framework hands it a task image, runs commands, file operations and tests in the returned sandbox across tool calls, and releases it. Sandman manages creation, readiness and cleanup independently of the model. Training shapes this service: creates arrive in bursts, large images are slow to pull, timeouts and cancellations leave sandboxes behind, prewarmed pods sit idle, and grading needs controlled run conditions (§ 2 – 4 ). We use SWE training as a running example and the primary evaluation workload.
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍 Sandman，这是我们的团队在共享的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) 集群上构建并运营的沙箱服务（图 2 ）。 它为多个生产级智能体强化学习（RL）工作负载提供服务。 训练框架向它交付一个任务镜像，在返回的沙箱中跨工具调用执行命令、文件操作和测试，然后释放该沙箱。 Sandman 独立于模型来管理沙箱的创建、就绪和清理。 训练任务塑造了这个服务：创建请求成批到达，大型镜像拉取缓慢，超时和取消会遗留沙箱，预热的 Pod 闲置等待，而评分需要受控的运行条件（§ 2 – 4 ）。 我们以 SWE 训练作为贯穿全文的示例和主要评估工作负载。

sents.en: We present Sandman, the sandbox service our team built and operates on a shared Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) cluster (Figure 2 ).
sents.zh: 我们介绍 Sandman，这是我们的团队在共享的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) 集群上构建并运营的沙箱服务（图 2 ）。

sents.en: Training shapes this service: creates arrive in bursts, large images are slow to pull, timeouts and cancellations leave sandboxes behind, prewarmed pods sit idle, and grading needs controlled run conditions (§ 2 – 4 ).
sents.zh: 训练任务塑造了这个服务：创建请求成批到达，大型镜像拉取缓慢，超时和取消会遗留沙箱，预热的 Pod 闲置等待，而评分需要受控的运行条件（§ 2 – 4 ）。

sents.en: We use SWE training as a running example and the primary evaluation workload.
sents.zh: 我们以 SWE 训练作为贯穿全文的示例和主要评估工作负载。

paragraphs.en: Each sandbox is an ordinary pod on the cluster’s CPU nodes, started from the task’s unmodified image with a small daemon mounted in; Sandman adds no node daemon or container runtime. A provider creates, paces, spreads and deletes the pods and owns each create until its pod is handed out or deleted, even after its caller gives up. A per-job pool paces creates and may prewarm pods. Our SWE integration grades each patch in a separate pod, never-used by default, after a probe checks the declared run conditions it can read. Production here means daily internal use for model development, with no external customers or service-level agreement; our training campaigns, sets of training runs, predate several mechanisms this paper describes (Table 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个沙盒都是集群 CPU 节点上的一个普通 pod，从任务未修改的镜像启动，并挂载一个小型守护进程；Sandman 不添加任何节点守护进程或容器运行时。 提供者负责创建、限速、分散和删除这些 pod，并在每次创建中直到其 pod 被分发或删除之前都拥有该 pod，即使调用者已经放弃。 每个作业的池对创建进行限速，并可以预热 pod。 我们的 SWE 集成在一个单独的 pod 中对每个补丁进行评分，默认情况下从未使用，在探测检查了它能读取的已声明运行条件之后。 这里的生产环境指的是用于模型开发的日常内部使用，没有外部客户或服务水平协议；我们的训练战役（训练运行集合）早于本文描述的若干机制（表 4）。

paragraphs.en: Sandman, a service that turns a task image into a stateful sandbox a training framework acquires, uses across tool calls and releases, built from ordinary pods on a shared training cluster, whereas purpose-built fleets Huang et al. (2026) and hosted runtimes E2B (2026) ; Modal Labs (2026) ; Daytona (2026) run their own infrastructure. Sandman held 11,858 concurrent tiny sandboxes in a scale test, and in October 2026 four production SWE campaigns, 122 runs on up to 432 B200 GPUs, created 3.13 million sandboxes on it (§ 5.1 , § 5.2 ).

paragraphs.en: Design considerations for RL training sandboxes, each with its cost: where to run them, how to create and place them, when to prewarm, who owns cleanup, how to keep grades valid and how to isolate them (§ 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 设计用于强化学习训练沙盒时的考量，每一项都有其成本：在哪里运行它们、如何创建和放置它们、何时预热、由谁负责清理、如何保持评分有效以及如何隔离它们（§ 4）。

paragraphs.en: An open-source release of Sandman’s daemon, provider and pool, to be published.
paragraphs.zh: Sandman 的守护进程（daemon）、提供者（provider）与资源池（pool）的开源版本即将发布。

paragraphs.en: Measurements and lessons from production and controlled runs: what bounds startup, what prewarming buys and costs, where sandbox waits fall in training, and the failures we met (§ 5 , § 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 来自生产环境和受控运行的测量与经验教训：什么限制了启动、预热带来什么收益与成本、沙箱等待在训练中处于何处，以及我们遇到的故障（§ 5 , § 6 ）。

paragraphs.en: The four production campaigns analyzed here train coding agents on SWE-bench Verified Jimenez et al. (2023) ; Chowdhury et al. (2024) ; some experiments use SWE-Gym Pan et al. (2024) . A task is a GitHub issue, the repository at the benchmark’s base commit, and tests that check a fix; the benchmark ships an image per task. A rollout first acquires a sandbox started from that image. The agent harness then alternates between asking the model for its next action and running that action with shell, read, write and edit tools, for tens of turns. When the agent stops, the trainer extracts the patch as a diff against the base commit and applies it in a separate sandbox from the same image. The trainer runs the task’s tests there, turns the verdict into a group relative policy optimization (GRPO) Shao et al. (2024) reward and releases both sandboxes.
paragraphs.zh: 本文分析的四个生产训练活动都在 SWE-bench Verified（Jimenez et al. (2023)；Chowdhury et al. (2024)）上训练编码智能体；部分实验使用 SWE-Gym（Pan et al. (2024)）。 一个任务是一个 GitHub issue、基准基准提交（base commit）时的仓库，以及检查修复的测试；基准为每个任务提供一个镜像。 一次 rollout 首先获取一个从该镜像启动的沙箱。 然后，智能体框架在向模型询问下一步动作与使用 shell、读取、写入和编辑工具执行该动作之间交替进行，持续数十轮。 当智能体停止时，训练器将该补丁提取为相对于基准提交的 diff，并在来自同一镜像的另一个沙箱中应用它。 训练器在那里运行该任务的测试，将判定结果转化为组相对策略优化（GRPO）（Shao et al. (2024)）奖励，并释放两个沙箱。

paragraphs.en: Two properties of this workload shape Sandman. First, a sandbox must keep the rollout’s files and processes between calls, so it cannot be swapped mid-rollout. Second, training is asynchronous: dozens of trajectories per run are in flight while the learner trains on completed, graded groups. Asynchrony can hide some sandbox latency, but slower acquisition can still reduce throughput by holding in-flight slots longer. A rollout’s record is its trajectory ; an attempt is one agent-session start. An acquisition lasts from the trainer’s request until the trainer holds a usable sandbox and may include a create , which ends when the new sandbox’s daemon answers. Our four production campaigns , A–D, each a set of training runs, ran in October 2026 (Table A2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 工作负载的两个特性塑造了 Sandman。 首先，沙箱必须在多次调用之间保留该 rollout 的文件和进程，因此不能在 rollout 中途被替换。 其次，训练是异步的：每次运行中会有数十条轨迹同时进行，而学习器则在已完成并评分的组上进行训练。 异步可以隐藏部分沙箱延迟，但较慢的获取仍会因更长时间占用进行中的槽位而降低吞吐量。 一个 rollout 的记录就是它的轨迹；一次尝试是一次智能体会话的启动。 一次获取从训练器发出请求开始，直到训练器持有一个可用的沙箱为止，其中可能包含一次创建，创建在新沙箱的守护进程应答时结束。 我们的四个生产活动 A–D（每个都是一组训练运行）于 2026 年 10 月进行（表 A2）。

sents.en: Our four production campaigns , A–D, each a set of training runs, ran in October 2026 (Table A2 ).
sents.zh: 我们的四个生产活动 A–D（每个都是一组训练运行）于 2026 年 10 月进行（表 A2）。

paragraphs.en: One training run creates thousands of sandboxes, and many runs share the cluster. Our 122 October runs averaged about 26,000 sandboxes each. A run starts many trajectories together: 64 within one second in campaign A. When two of A’s runs started together, sandbox creates reached 132 in one second, against a campaign mean of 1.8 per second (Figure 1 a). Campaign C kept 256 trajectories in flight per run, campaign D ran up to 27 runs at once, and each trajectory also needs one or two grading pods. Every create passes the cluster’s shared admission, scheduling and network configuration, so the creation path must absorb bursts that average rates and live-pod counts hide. The managed service we tried first could not meet this demand (§ 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一次训练运行会创建数千个沙箱，而多个运行共享同一个集群。 我们十月的 122 次运行平均每次创建约 26,000 个沙箱。 一次运行会同时启动许多轨迹：在活动 A 中，一秒内启动了 64 条轨迹。 当活动 A 的两次运行同时启动时，沙箱创建速率在一秒内达到 132 个，而该活动的平均速率仅为每秒 1.8 个（图 1 a）。 活动 C 在每次运行中保持 256 条轨迹同时在途，活动 D 最多同时运行 27 次，并且每条轨迹还需要一到两个评分 pod。 每次创建都要经过集群共享的准入、调度和网络配置，因此创建路径必须能够承受平均速率和活跃 pod 数量所掩盖的突发流量。 我们最初尝试的托管服务无法满足这一需求（§ 4.1）。

paragraphs.en: A sandbox can be a service, but training shapes it. Tool execution has a clean boundary: the trainer acquires an environment, sends it commands and file operations, and releases it. A sandbox service can therefore stay independent of the model. Training still sets its requirements. A rollout sandbox must keep its files and processes between tool calls while the model generates its next action, and that waiting took 74–91% of its lifetime in our production traces (Figure 1 c). A production run drew on 24–88 task images, and about 80% of requests for an image arrived within ten seconds of another request for it (Figure 1 d). Prewarming could serve these repeats, but a prewarmed pod reserves resources and serves only compatible requests. Tasks also differ in the outbound access their tests need: of the 15 reference patches whose verdicts flipped under changed run conditions, 11 flipped with outbound traffic denied. Network rules must be set per job and checked before grading.
paragraphs.zh: 沙箱可以是一种服务，但训练塑造了它的形态。 工具执行有一条清晰的边界：训练器获取一个环境，向其发送命令和文件操作，然后将其释放。 因此，沙箱服务可以保持独立于模型之外。 但训练仍然决定着它的需求。 在模型生成下一步动作期间，rollout 沙箱必须在多次工具调用之间保留其文件和进程，而在我们的生产跟踪记录中，这种等待占了其生命周期的 74–91%（图 1 c）。 一次生产运行会用到 24–88 个任务镜像，并且对一个镜像的请求中约有 80% 会在另一请求发出后的十秒内到达（图 1 d）。 预热可以服务这些重复请求，但一个预热后的 pod 会占用资源，且只能服务兼容的请求。 各任务在测试所需的外向访问上也各不相同：在因运行条件改变而判定结果翻转的 15 个参考补丁中，有 11 个是在拒绝外向流量的情况下翻转的。 网络规则必须按作业设置，并在评分前进行检查。

sents.zh: 沙箱可以是一种服务，但训练塑造了它的形态。

paragraphs.en: Sandman’s daemon, provider and optional pool support the SWE trainer integration in Figure 2 . Table 1 lists its calls.
paragraphs.zh: Sandman 的守护进程（daemon）、提供者（provider）以及可选的资源池支持图 2 中的 SWE 训练器集成。表 1 列出了其调用。

paragraphs.en: execd runs the agent’s commands inside the unmodified task image. Every sandbox runs execd , a small HTTP server that runs commands, reads and writes files, sets environment variables, resets its shell and reports health. One persistent bash process per sandbox keeps the working directory, environment and background processes across tool calls. execd needs only bash and Python 3, and jobs mount it read-only, so task images run unmodified.
paragraphs.zh: execd 在未经修改的任务镜像中运行智能体的命令。 每个沙箱都运行 execd，这是一个小型 HTTP 服务器，用于运行命令、读写文件、设置环境变量、重置 shell 并报告健康状态。 每个沙箱中有一个持久的 bash 进程，在多次工具调用之间保留工作目录、环境和后台进程。execd 只需要 bash 和 Python 3，并且任务以只读方式挂载它，因此任务镜像可以不经修改地运行。

sents.en: execd runs the agent’s commands inside the unmodified task image.
sents.zh: execd 在未经修改的任务镜像中运行智能体的命令。

sents.zh: 每个沙箱都运行 execd，这是一个小型 HTTP 服务器，用于运行命令、读写文件、设置环境变量、重置 shell 并报告健康状态。

paragraphs.en: The provider turns one sandbox request into one pod. The request names an image, CPU, memory and a workspace. The pod’s requests equal its limits, it carries no service-account token, and an owner reference ties it to the trainer’s pod. A sandbox is ready when its readiness probe passes and execd answers the provider’s poll, within a per-job budget that includes the image pull. The provider also paces and spreads creates, installs the network guards and owns each create until it settles (§ 4.2 – 4.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 提供方将一个沙箱请求转换为一个 Pod。 该请求指定镜像、CPU、内存和工作区。 该 Pod 的请求值等于其限制值，它不携带服务账号令牌，并通过一个属主引用将其与训练器的 Pod 绑定。 当沙箱的就绪探针通过且 execd 响应提供方的轮询时，沙箱即就绪，须在包含镜像拉取在内的每个作业预算时间内完成。 提供方还会对创建操作进行限速与分散，安装网络防护，并在每次创建操作尘埃落定之前对其负责（§ 4.2 – 4.6）。

paragraphs.en: An optional pool prewarms pods and paces the creates it makes. The pool, a Ray Moritz et al. (2017) actor shared by the trainer’s workers, keeps never-used pods per (image, base commit), caps live pods and concurrent creates, and paces creates with one token bucket (§ 4.2 , § 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个可选的资源池负责预热 pod，并对其创建操作进行节奏控制。 该资源池是一个 Ray Moritz 等人提出的。 (2017) 由训练器的工作进程共享的智能体，它为每个（镜像、基础提交）保留从未使用过的 pod，限制活跃 pod 数量和并发创建数，并通过一个令牌桶来控制创建的节奏（§ 4.2、§ 4.3）。

sents.zh: 一个可选的资源池负责预热 pod，并对其创建操作进行节奏控制。

sents.en: The pool, a Ray Moritz et al.
sents.zh: 该资源池是一个 Ray Moritz 等人提出的。

sents.en: (2017) actor shared by the trainer’s workers, keeps never-used pods per (image, base commit), caps live pods and concurrent creates, and paces creates with one token bucket (§ 4.2 , § 4.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Our SWE trainer acquires a sandbox for each rollout and a separate one for each grading. The trainer runs one agent worker, a Ray actor, per agent slot. The worker takes a task (step 1 in Figure 2 ) and acquires a sandbox (2). The harness’s tools call execd over HTTP at the pod’s address, and its model calls go through a local proxy to the engines (3). When the agent stops, the worker captures the patch (4), has it graded in a separate sandbox per suite (5), releases both (6) and sends the learner the reward (7).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的 SWE 训练器为每次 rollout 获取一个沙盒，并为每次评分获取一个单独的沙盒。 训练器为每个智能体槽位运行一个智能体工作器（一个 Ray actor）。 工作器领取一个任务（图 2 中的步骤 1）并获取一个沙盒（2）。 该框架的工具通过 HTTP 调用 pod 地址上的 execd，其模型调用则通过本地代理发送到引擎（3）。 当智能体停止时，工作器捕获补丁（4），在每个测试套件对应的单独沙盒中进行评分（5），释放两者（6），并将奖励发送给学习器（7）。

paragraphs.en: Sandman depends on shared cluster services: the API server, admission webhooks, the pod network (the Virtual Private Cloud Container Network Interface plugin, VPC CNI), DNS and node groups. Our team also runs these services for the cluster’s other workloads. Sandman’s service account creates and deletes pods in its namespace but can neither read the webhooks nor create network policies. Within Sandman, the pool or the worker owns a pod while it is in use, the provider performs every delete, and the owner reference lets Kubernetes delete leftovers at job end.
paragraphs.zh: Sandman 依赖共享的集群服务：API 服务器、准入 Webhook、Pod 网络（Virtual Private Cloud 容器网络接口插件，VPC CNI）、DNS 以及节点组。 我们的团队还为集群中的其他工作负载运行这些服务。 Sandman 的服务账户可以在其命名空间中创建和删除 Pod，但既不能读取 Webhook，也不能创建网络策略。 在 Sandman 内部，资源池或工作者（worker）在 Pod 使用期间拥有该 Pod，所有删除操作均由提供者（provider）执行，而属主引用（owner reference）则让 Kubernetes 在任务结束时清理残留资源。

paragraphs.en: We trust our trainer, our graders and the cluster’s control plane, not model-written code or other workloads’ pods. Model-written code comes from our own models and runs as root in runc containers that share each node’s kernel with other pods (§ 4.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们信任我们的训练器、评分器和集群的控制平面，而不信任模型编写的代码或其他工作负载的 pod。 模型编写的代码来自我们自己的模型，并以 root 身份在 runc 容器中运行，这些容器与其他 pod 共享每个节点的内核（§ 4.6）。

paragraphs.en: Each subsection states a design choice and its cost.
paragraphs.zh: 每个小节都会说明一个设计选择及其代价。

paragraphs.en: The managed service we tried held constant what training needs to vary. We first used Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Code Interpreter Amazon Web Services (2026a) . The service sizes every session at 2 vCPUs and 8 GB with a 10 GB disk, so a job cannot size a sandbox to its task, and it could not run task images, which ruled out SWE tasks. Its default per-account limits are 1,000 concurrent sessions, fewer than campaign D’s up to 1,728 trajectories in flight, and 30 calls per second on session starts, stops and invokes Amazon Web Services (2026b) . The limits are adjustable; we had starts and invokes raised. When a batch of our Python and math rollouts recycled sessions together, stop calls reached about 117 per second, inflated by our retries, and trajectories timed out. Hosted runtimes E2B (2026) ; Modal Labs (2026) ; Daytona (2026) run custom images behind their own APIs; we did not test them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们尝试过的托管服务把本应随任务变化的部分固定死了。 我们首先使用了 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Code Interpreter（Amazon Web Services，2026a）。 该服务把每个会话都固定为 2 个 vCPU、8 GB 内存和 10 GB 磁盘，因此任务无法根据自身需求调整沙盒的规格，而且它无法运行任务镜像，这就排除了 SWE 类任务。 其默认的每账户限额为 1,000 个并发会话，低于活动 D 最多同时进行的 1,728 条轨迹，并且在会话启动、停止和调用上的限制为每秒 30 次（Amazon Web Services，2026b）。 这些限额是可以调整的；我们申请提高了启动和调用的配额。 当我们的一批 Python 和数学 rollout 一起复用会话时，停止调用达到了每秒约 117 次（其中包含我们重试带来的膨胀），导致轨迹超时。 托管运行时（E2B，2026；Modal Labs，2026；Daytona，2026）通过各自的 API 运行自定义镜像；我们没有对它们进行测试。

sents.en: The managed service we tried held constant what training needs to vary.
sents.zh: 我们尝试过的托管服务把本应随任务变化的部分固定死了。

sents.en: We first used Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Code Interpreter Amazon Web Services (2026a) .
sents.zh: 我们首先使用了 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Code Interpreter（Amazon Web Services，2026a）。

sents.en: The service sizes every session at 2 vCPUs and 8 GB with a 10 GB disk, so a job cannot size a sandbox to its task, and it could not run task images, which ruled out SWE tasks.
sents.zh: 该服务把每个会话都固定为 2 个 vCPU、8 GB 内存和 10 GB 磁盘，因此任务无法根据自身需求调整沙盒的规格，而且它无法运行任务镜像，这就排除了 SWE 类任务。

sents.en: Its default per-account limits are 1,000 concurrent sessions, fewer than campaign D’s up to 1,728 trajectories in flight, and 30 calls per second on session starts, stops and invokes Amazon Web Services (2026b) .
sents.zh: 其默认的每账户限额为 1,000 个并发会话，低于活动 D 最多同时进行的 1,728 条轨迹，并且在会话启动、停止和调用上的限制为每秒 30 次（Amazon Web Services，2026b）。

sents.en: The limits are adjustable; we had starts and invokes raised.
sents.zh: 这些限额是可以调整的；我们申请提高了启动和调用的配额。

sents.en: When a batch of our Python and math rollouts recycled sessions together, stop calls reached about 117 per second, inflated by our retries, and trajectories timed out.
sents.zh: 当我们的一批 Python 和数学 rollout 一起复用会话时，停止调用达到了每秒约 117 次（其中包含我们重试带来的膨胀），导致轨迹超时。

sents.en: Hosted runtimes E2B (2026) ; Modal Labs (2026) ; Daytona (2026) run custom images behind their own APIs; we did not test them.
sents.zh: 托管运行时（E2B，2026；Modal Labs，2026；Daytona，2026）通过各自的 API 运行自定义镜像；我们没有对它们进行测试。

paragraphs.en: Self-managed sandboxes run on the training cluster’s CPU nodes, not its GPUs. Each sandbox is a pod on the CPU nodes of the EKS cluster that already runs our training jobs. In mid-October these were 378 96-vCPU nodes of four families (c5d, m5d, m6id, m8id) with local disks. A job sets its sandboxes’ image, size, readiness budget and network rules, and its agent workers reach them over the cluster network. Unlike a node-local container manager, Sandman needs no privileged daemon on the nodes. The cost is running the creation path, which shares the API server, webhooks, pod network and nodes with others.
paragraphs.zh: 自管理沙箱运行在训练集群的 CPU 节点上，而非其 GPU 上。 每个沙箱是 EKS 集群 CPU 节点上的一个 pod，该集群已经在运行我们的训练任务。 截至 10 月中旬，这些节点是来自四个系列（c5d、m5d、m6id、m8id）的 378 个带本地磁盘的 96 vCPU 节点。 任务可以设置其沙箱的镜像、规格、就绪预算和网络规则，其智能体工作进程通过集群网络访问这些沙箱。 与节点本地的容器管理器不同，Sandman 不需要在节点上运行特权守护进程。 代价是要运行创建路径，该路径会与其他负载共享 API 服务器、webhook、pod 网络和节点。

sents.en: Self-managed sandboxes run on the training cluster’s CPU nodes, not its GPUs.
sents.zh: 自管理沙箱运行在训练集群的 CPU 节点上，而非其 GPU 上。

sents.en: Each sandbox is a pod on the CPU nodes of the EKS cluster that already runs our training jobs.
sents.zh: 每个沙箱是 EKS 集群 CPU 节点上的一个 pod，该集群已经在运行我们的训练任务。

sents.en: In mid-October these were 378 96-vCPU nodes of four families (c5d, m5d, m6id, m8id) with local disks.
sents.zh: 截至 10 月中旬，这些节点是来自四个系列（c5d、m5d、m6id、m8id）的 378 个带本地磁盘的 96 vCPU 节点。

sents.en: A job sets its sandboxes’ image, size, readiness budget and network rules, and its agent workers reach them over the cluster network.
sents.zh: 任务可以设置其沙箱的镜像、规格、就绪预算和网络规则，其智能体工作进程通过集群网络访问这些沙箱。

sents.en: Unlike a node-local container manager, Sandman needs no privileged daemon on the nodes.
sents.zh: 与节点本地的容器管理器不同，Sandman 不需要在节点上运行特权守护进程。

sents.en: The cost is running the creation path, which shares the API server, webhooks, pod network and nodes with others.
sents.zh: 代价是要运行创建路径，该路径会与其他负载共享 API 服务器、webhook、pod 网络和节点。

paragraphs.en: Sufficient capacity does not guarantee fast startup. Resource requests, subnet addresses and lifecycle operations limit creates at different times. At 8 GiB per sandbox, a c5d node holds 21 sandboxes by memory and 46 by CPU. Every create passes the API server, admission webhooks, scheduler, address assignment and kubelet. The network plugin Amazon Web Services (2026d) assigns addresses from a few spares it keeps warm per node, two in our campaigns and experiments, so a burst packed onto a few nodes waited for addresses while the cluster had room (Table A14 ).
paragraphs.zh: 容量充足并不能保证快速启动。 资源请求、子网地址和生命周期操作会在不同时间限制创建操作。 按每个沙箱 8 GiB 计算，一台 c5d 节点按内存可容纳 21 个沙箱，按 CPU 可容纳 46 个。 每次创建都要经过 API 服务器、准入 webhook、调度器、地址分配和 kubelet。 网络插件 Amazon Web Services (2026d) 从每个节点预先保温的少量备用地址中分配地址，在我们的实验和测试中是每节点两个，因此当突发负载集中到少数节点时，即使集群仍有余量，创建操作也在等待地址（表 A14）。

sents.en: Sufficient capacity does not guarantee fast startup.
sents.zh: 容量充足并不能保证快速启动。

sents.en: Resource requests, subnet addresses and lifecycle operations limit creates at different times.
sents.zh: 资源请求、子网地址和生命周期操作会在不同时间限制创建操作。

sents.en: At 8 GiB per sandbox, a c5d node holds 21 sandboxes by memory and 46 by CPU.
sents.zh: 按每个沙箱 8 GiB 计算，一台 c5d 节点按内存可容纳 21 个沙箱，按 CPU 可容纳 46 个。

sents.en: Every create passes the API server, admission webhooks, scheduler, address assignment and kubelet.
sents.zh: 每次创建都要经过 API 服务器、准入 webhook、调度器、地址分配和 kubelet。

sents.en: The network plugin Amazon Web Services (2026d) assigns addresses from a few spares it keeps warm per node, two in our campaigns and experiments, so a burst packed onto a few nodes waited for addresses while the cluster had room (Table A14 ).
sents.zh: 网络插件 Amazon Web Services (2026d) 从每个节点预先保温的少量备用地址中分配地址，在我们的实验和测试中是每节点两个，因此当突发负载集中到少数节点时，即使集群仍有余量，创建操作也在等待地址（表 A14）。

paragraphs.en: Pool-mediated creates share a pacing budget. Each provider paces its creates with a token bucket. With the pool, one provider, bucket and create cap serve every create the pool makes: on-demand acquisitions, warm builds and replacements. With no warm pods the pool still creates on demand; our SWE jobs run it this way. When the pool raises an error other than a timeout, such as a full pod cap, the trainer’s worker makes one direct create through its own provider, outside the job’s bucket and cap; 4.3% of gradings in the pre-registered comparison took this path (Appendix K ). The pool’s limits are therefore not a hard job-wide admission limit. Without the pool, each agent worker paces only its own creates, and simultaneous creates from different workers can still form a burst. No budget spans jobs, so concurrent jobs’ rates add up. In the scale ramp, one pool with no warm pods and a test pacer held 12,000 acquires fired at once to 20–25 creates per second (§ 5.2 ). The provider spreads sandboxes with a soft topology constraint (maximum skew 2), a scheduler preference rather than a per-node limit. CPU nodes keep eight spare addresses warm, the most a spread burst put on one node in our tests.
paragraphs.zh: 池中介的创建共享一个节奏预算。 每个提供者用令牌桶为其创建设置节奏。 有了池，一个提供者、一个令牌桶和一个创建上限服务于池进行的每一次创建：按需获取、预热构建和替换。 在没有预热 pod 的情况下，池仍然按需创建；我们的 SWE 任务就是以这种方式运行的。 当池抛出超时以外的错误（例如 pod 上限已满）时，训练器的 worker 会在任务的令牌桶和上限之外，通过其自身的提供者直接进行一次创建；在预注册比较中，4.3% 的评分走了这条路径（附录 K）。 因此，池的限制并不是任务范围内的硬性准入限制。 没有池时，每个智能体 worker 只为自身的创建设置节奏，而来自不同 worker 的同时创建仍可能形成突发。 没有跨任务的预算，因此并发任务的速率会叠加。 在规模爬升中，一个没有预热 pod 的池加上一个测试 pacer，将同时触发的 12,000 次获取限制在每秒 20–25 次创建（§5.2）。 提供者通过一个软拓扑约束（最大偏斜为 2）来分散沙箱，这是一种调度器偏好，而非每节点限制。 CPU 节点保持八个备用地址处于预热状态，这是我们测试中一次分散突发在单个节点上达到的最大值。

sents.en: Pool-mediated creates share a pacing budget.
sents.zh: 池中介的创建共享一个节奏预算。

sents.en: Each provider paces its creates with a token bucket.
sents.zh: 每个提供者用令牌桶为其创建设置节奏。

sents.en: With the pool, one provider, bucket and create cap serve every create the pool makes: on-demand acquisitions, warm builds and replacements.
sents.zh: 有了池，一个提供者、一个令牌桶和一个创建上限服务于池进行的每一次创建：按需获取、预热构建和替换。

sents.en: With no warm pods the pool still creates on demand; our SWE jobs run it this way.
sents.zh: 在没有预热 pod 的情况下，池仍然按需创建；我们的 SWE 任务就是以这种方式运行的。

sents.en: When the pool raises an error other than a timeout, such as a full pod cap, the trainer’s worker makes one direct create through its own provider, outside the job’s bucket and cap; 4.3% of gradings in the pre-registered comparison took this path (Appendix K ).
sents.zh: 当池抛出超时以外的错误（例如 pod 上限已满）时，训练器的 worker 会在任务的令牌桶和上限之外，通过其自身的提供者直接进行一次创建；在预注册比较中，4.3% 的评分走了这条路径（附录 K）。

sents.en: The pool’s limits are therefore not a hard job-wide admission limit.
sents.zh: 因此，池的限制并不是任务范围内的硬性准入限制。

sents.en: Without the pool, each agent worker paces only its own creates, and simultaneous creates from different workers can still form a burst.
sents.zh: 没有池时，每个智能体 worker 只为自身的创建设置节奏，而来自不同 worker 的同时创建仍可能形成突发。

sents.en: No budget spans jobs, so concurrent jobs’ rates add up.
sents.zh: 没有跨任务的预算，因此并发任务的速率会叠加。

sents.en: In the scale ramp, one pool with no warm pods and a test pacer held 12,000 acquires fired at once to 20–25 creates per second (§ 5.2 ).
sents.zh: 在规模爬升中，一个没有预热 pod 的池加上一个测试 pacer，将同时触发的 12,000 次获取限制在每秒 20–25 次创建（§5.2）。

sents.en: The provider spreads sandboxes with a soft topology constraint (maximum skew 2), a scheduler preference rather than a per-node limit.
sents.zh: 提供者通过一个软拓扑约束（最大偏斜为 2）来分散沙箱，这是一种调度器偏好，而非每节点限制。

sents.en: CPU nodes keep eight spare addresses warm, the most a spread burst put on one node in our tests.
sents.zh: CPU 节点保持八个备用地址处于预热状态，这是我们测试中一次分散突发在单个节点上达到的最大值。

paragraphs.en: Agents call their sandbox by pod address, not through a Service. Our trainer creates only the pod, sends the harness each trajectory’s address and waits for an acknowledgement; Service environment variables are off. An earlier design put each agent slot behind a Kubernetes Service with a stable name, because the harness read its sandbox address once while the pod changed every trajectory. But Kubernetes injects every Service’s variables into each new container in the namespace The Kubernetes Authors (2026a) . A pod behind a Service is reachable only once its route is programmed, and each Service is another object to create.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体通过 pod 地址调用它们的沙箱，而不是通过 Service。 我们的训练器只创建 pod，把每条轨迹的地址发送给 harness 并等待确认；Service 环境变量是关闭的。 早期设计把每个智能体槽位放在一个名称稳定的 Kubernetes Service 之后，因为 harness 只读取一次沙箱地址，而 pod 每条轨迹都会变化。 但 Kubernetes 会把命名空间中每个 Service 的变量注入到每个新容器中 The Kubernetes Authors (2026a)。 Service 之后的 pod 只有在其路由被配置好后才可访问，而且每个 Service 都是需要创建的另一个对象。

sents.en: Agents call their sandbox by pod address, not through a Service.
sents.zh: 智能体通过 pod 地址调用它们的沙箱，而不是通过 Service。

sents.en: Our trainer creates only the pod, sends the harness each trajectory’s address and waits for an acknowledgement; Service environment variables are off.
sents.zh: 我们的训练器只创建 pod，把每条轨迹的地址发送给 harness 并等待确认；Service 环境变量是关闭的。

sents.en: An earlier design put each agent slot behind a Kubernetes Service with a stable name, because the harness read its sandbox address once while the pod changed every trajectory.
sents.zh: 早期设计把每个智能体槽位放在一个名称稳定的 Kubernetes Service 之后，因为 harness 只读取一次沙箱地址，而 pod 每条轨迹都会变化。

sents.en: But Kubernetes injects every Service’s variables into each new container in the namespace The Kubernetes Authors (2026a) .
sents.zh: 但 Kubernetes 会把命名空间中每个 Service 的变量注入到每个新容器中 The Kubernetes Authors (2026a)。

sents.en: A pod behind a Service is reachable only once its route is programmed, and each Service is another object to create.
sents.zh: Service 之后的 pod 只有在其路由被配置好后才可访问，而且每个 Service 都是需要创建的另一个对象。

paragraphs.en: Pacing and spreading trade caller wait and image pulls for a shorter tail in our tests. Pacing adds our queue to a caller’s wait, and spreading pulls images onto more nodes. We did not place sandboxes by image: that packs creates onto fewer nodes, where address failures concentrated, and the scheduler’s image-locality score sees only a node’s 50 largest images The Kubernetes Authors (2026b) . Eight spare addresses per node, not two, reserve about 2,300 more over the CPU pool; larger bursts need more nodes or pacing.
paragraphs.zh: 节奏控制与分散调度调用者的等待和镜像拉取，在我们的测试中缩短了长尾。 节奏控制把我们的队列加入调用者的等待，分散调度把镜像拉取到更多节点上。 我们没有按镜像放置沙箱：那样会把创建任务集中到更少的节点上，而地址失败正是集中在这些节点上，并且调度器的镜像局部性评分只看到节点上最大的 50 个镜像 The Kubernetes Authors (2026b)。 每个节点保留八个而非两个备用地址，可在 CPU 池之上多预留约 2,300 个地址；更大的突发需要更多节点或节奏控制。

sents.en: Pacing and spreading trade caller wait and image pulls for a shorter tail in our tests.
sents.zh: 节奏控制与分散调度调用者的等待和镜像拉取，在我们的测试中缩短了长尾。

sents.en: Pacing adds our queue to a caller’s wait, and spreading pulls images onto more nodes.
sents.zh: 节奏控制把我们的队列加入调用者的等待，分散调度把镜像拉取到更多节点上。

sents.en: We did not place sandboxes by image: that packs creates onto fewer nodes, where address failures concentrated, and the scheduler’s image-locality score sees only a node’s 50 largest images The Kubernetes Authors (2026b) .
sents.zh: 我们没有按镜像放置沙箱：那样会把创建任务集中到更少的节点上，而地址失败正是集中在这些节点上，并且调度器的镜像局部性评分只看到节点上最大的 50 个镜像 The Kubernetes Authors (2026b)。

sents.en: Eight spare addresses per node, not two, reserve about 2,300 more over the CPU pool; larger bursts need more nodes or pacing.
sents.zh: 每个节点保留八个而非两个备用地址，可在 CPU 池之上多预留约 2,300 个地址；更大的突发需要更多节点或节奏控制。

paragraphs.en: An on-demand create of a large image is fast only if its node holds it (§ 5.3 ). Nodes keep task images on local disks until disk pressure evicts them. An admission rule makes every create pull a tag reference, so a security fix can move a tag; a digest reference is pulled only when the node lacks it. Layers already on the node are reused either way.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当节点已持有某个大镜像时，按需创建它才会很快（§ 5.3）。 节点将任务镜像保留在本地磁盘上，直到磁盘压力将其驱逐。 准入规则使每次创建都会拉取一个标签引用，因此安全修复可以移动标签；只有当节点缺少该镜像时才会拉取摘要引用。 节点上已存在的层在两种方式下都会被复用。

sents.en: An on-demand create of a large image is fast only if its node holds it (§ 5.3 ).
sents.zh: 只有当节点已持有某个大镜像时，按需创建它才会很快（§ 5.3）。

sents.en: Nodes keep task images on local disks until disk pressure evicts them.
sents.zh: 节点将任务镜像保留在本地磁盘上，直到磁盘压力将其驱逐。

sents.en: An admission rule makes every create pull a tag reference, so a security fix can move a tag; a digest reference is pulled only when the node lacks it.
sents.zh: 准入规则使每次创建都会拉取一个标签引用，因此安全修复可以移动标签；只有当节点缺少该镜像时才会拉取摘要引用。

sents.en: Layers already on the node are reused either way.
sents.zh: 节点上已存在的层在两种方式下都会被复用。

paragraphs.en: We create on demand by default; warm and reused pods are options. In our asynchronous trainer, rollout creation overlaps other work, while a warm pod, started but never used, holds its full request as it waits. The warm pool keeps never-used pods per (image, base commit). The pool hands one out only after a health check and only if its CPU, memory and workspace equal the request’s. It starts a replacement create whenever it hands out a pod and deletes pods of images not requested within a timeout. Reuse is a second option, for grading pods. Since git reset and git clean do not return a pod to its starting state, at create execd records a baseline of what graders were seen to change (repository, installed packages, system and home directories, environment, time zone, processes). After a grading, execd undoes differences exactly or sends the pod to deletion. A pod is reused at most 8 times and retired when its grading contradicts an earlier one.
paragraphs.zh: 我们默认按需创建；预热 pod 和复用 pod 是可选项。 在我们的异步训练器中，rollout 的创建与其他工作重叠进行，而一个已启动但从未被使用的预热 pod 在等待时会一直占用其全部请求资源。 预热池按（镜像、基础提交）保存从未使用过的 pod。 只有在通过健康检查且其 CPU、内存和工作区与请求相匹配时，池才会分发一个 pod。 每当分发一个 pod 时，它都会启动一次替代性的创建，并删除在超时时间内未被请求的镜像所对应的 pod。 复用是第二种可选项，适用于评分 pod。 由于 git reset 和 git clean 无法将 pod 恢复到初始状态，因此在创建时，execd 会记录一个基线，记录观察到评分器曾更改过的内容（仓库、已安装的软件包、系统目录和主目录、环境变量、时区、进程）。 在一次评分之后，execd 会精确地撤销差异，或将该 pod 送入删除流程。 一个 pod 最多被复用 8 次，并且当其评分结果与之前的评分相矛盾时即被退役。

sents.en: We create on demand by default; warm and reused pods are options.
sents.zh: 我们默认按需创建；预热 pod 和复用 pod 是可选项。

sents.en: In our asynchronous trainer, rollout creation overlaps other work, while a warm pod, started but never used, holds its full request as it waits.
sents.zh: 在我们的异步训练器中，rollout 的创建与其他工作重叠进行，而一个已启动但从未被使用的预热 pod 在等待时会一直占用其全部请求资源。

sents.en: The warm pool keeps never-used pods per (image, base commit).
sents.zh: 预热池按（镜像、基础提交）保存从未使用过的 pod。

sents.en: The pool hands one out only after a health check and only if its CPU, memory and workspace equal the request’s.
sents.zh: 只有在通过健康检查且其 CPU、内存和工作区与请求相匹配时，池才会分发一个 pod。

sents.en: It starts a replacement create whenever it hands out a pod and deletes pods of images not requested within a timeout.
sents.zh: 每当分发一个 pod 时，它都会启动一次替代性的创建，并删除在超时时间内未被请求的镜像所对应的 pod。

sents.en: Reuse is a second option, for grading pods.
sents.zh: 复用是第二种可选项，适用于评分 pod。

sents.en: Since git reset and git clean do not return a pod to its starting state, at create execd records a baseline of what graders were seen to change (repository, installed packages, system and home directories, environment, time zone, processes).
sents.zh: 由于 git reset 和 git clean 无法将 pod 恢复到初始状态，因此在创建时，execd 会记录一个基线，记录观察到评分器曾更改过的内容（仓库、已安装的软件包、系统目录和主目录、环境变量、时区、进程）。

sents.en: After a grading, execd undoes differences exactly or sends the pod to deletion.
sents.zh: 在一次评分之后，execd 会精确地撤销差异，或将该 pod 送入删除流程。

sents.en: A pod is reused at most 8 times and retired when its grading contradicts an earlier one.
sents.zh: 一个 pod 最多被复用 8 次，并且当其评分结果与之前的评分相矛盾时即被退役。

paragraphs.en: Only a digest reference fixes the image a warm pod serves. Warm pods are keyed by the image reference as requested. All our campaigns and experiments referenced task images by digest, so a warm pod, a rollout and its grading ran the same image. A tag, which each create resolves again, carries no such guarantee.
paragraphs.zh: 只有摘要引用才能固定温热 Pod 所服务的镜像。 温热 Pod 按照请求以镜像引用作为键。 我们所有的营销活动和实验都通过摘要引用任务镜像，因此温热 Pod、一次发布及其评分运行的都是同一个镜像。 标签则不提供这种保证，每次创建都会重新解析标签。

sents.en: Only a digest reference fixes the image a warm pod serves.
sents.zh: 只有摘要引用才能固定温热 Pod 所服务的镜像。

sents.en: Warm pods are keyed by the image reference as requested.
sents.zh: 温热 Pod 按照请求以镜像引用作为键。

sents.en: All our campaigns and experiments referenced task images by digest, so a warm pod, a rollout and its grading ran the same image.
sents.zh: 我们所有的营销活动和实验都通过摘要引用任务镜像，因此温热 Pod、一次发布及其评分运行的都是同一个镜像。

sents.en: A tag, which each create resolves again, carries no such guarantee.
sents.zh: 标签则不提供这种保证，每次创建都会重新解析标签。

paragraphs.en: Warm pods cost capacity image by image. A warm pod serves only its own image, so pools are sized per image by request rate, burst and create time. Because the pool replaces every pod it hands out, a reused pod returns to an already refilled pool; we did not test replacing only unreturned pods. We did not adopt lazy image loading, which needs another snapshotter on every node. Requests equal limits, so idle time between tool calls is a cost; we did not overcommit.
paragraphs.zh: 预热 Pod 按镜像逐个消耗容量。 一个预热 Pod 只服务自己的镜像，因此资源池按镜像、依据请求速率、突发量与创建时间来设定大小。 由于资源池会替换其分发出的每个 Pod，被复用的 Pod 会返回到已补充满的池中；我们未测试只替换未被归还的 Pod 的做法。 我们没有采用懒加载镜像的方式，因为那需要在每个节点上再部署一个快照器。 请求数等于限额，因此工具调用之间的空闲时间是一种成本；我们没有进行超卖。

sents.en: Warm pods cost capacity image by image.
sents.zh: 预热 Pod 按镜像逐个消耗容量。

sents.en: A warm pod serves only its own image, so pools are sized per image by request rate, burst and create time.
sents.zh: 一个预热 Pod 只服务自己的镜像，因此资源池按镜像、依据请求速率、突发量与创建时间来设定大小。

sents.en: Because the pool replaces every pod it hands out, a reused pod returns to an already refilled pool; we did not test replacing only unreturned pods.
sents.zh: 由于资源池会替换其分发出的每个 Pod，被复用的 Pod 会返回到已补充满的池中；我们未测试只替换未被归还的 Pod 的做法。

sents.en: We did not adopt lazy image loading, which needs another snapshotter on every node.
sents.zh: 我们没有采用懒加载镜像的方式，因为那需要在每个节点上再部署一个快照器。

sents.en: Requests equal limits, so idle time between tool calls is a cost; we did not overcommit.
sents.zh: 请求数等于限额，因此工具调用之间的空闲时间是一种成本；我们没有进行超卖。

paragraphs.en: Cancelling a caller does not cancel its create. A trainer may abandon an acquisition after a timeout although the API server has already accepted the pod. If the cancellation also cancels the caller’s cleanup, the pod becomes ready with nobody waiting for it, and a retry creates another pod; in a stress test, this path left at least 4,181 excess pods. Table 2 lists this and two other ways a pod outlives its caller. The provider therefore owns each create until it settles: the create runs even if its caller is cancelled, and cleanup runs on any exit, even a second cancellation. The pool keeps the create of a timed-out acquire: a late pod without an agent label becomes a warm pod, and any other late pod is deleted. A nonce on each create lets the provider find and delete a pod that the API stored but answered with an error. An unconfirmed delete is retried until the job drains; deletes pending when the provider’s event loop closes are lost, and the owner reference lets Kubernetes remove them.
paragraphs.zh: 取消调用方并不会取消其创建操作。 训练器可能在超时后放弃获取操作，尽管 API 服务器已经接受了该 Pod。 如果取消操作同时也取消了调用方的清理，该 Pod 会在无人等待的情况下变为就绪，而重试会创建另一个 Pod；在压力测试中，这条路径留下了至少 4,181 个多余的 Pod。 表 2 列出了这种情况以及 Pod 比其调用方存活更久的另外两种方式。 因此，提供者拥有每次创建操作直到其落定：即使调用方被取消，创建操作也会运行，并且清理在任何退出路径上都会运行，即使是第二次取消。 资源池会保留超时获取操作的创建：没有智能体标签的迟到 Pod 会成为温备 Pod，其他任何迟到的 Pod 则被删除。 每次创建操作上的随机数让提供者能够找到并删除已被 API 存储但返回了错误的 Pod。 未确认的删除会一直重试直到任务排空；当提供者的事件循环关闭时仍未完成的删除会丢失，而属主引用让 Kubernetes 移除它们。

sents.en: Cancelling a caller does not cancel its create.
sents.zh: 取消调用方并不会取消其创建操作。

sents.en: A trainer may abandon an acquisition after a timeout although the API server has already accepted the pod.
sents.zh: 训练器可能在超时后放弃获取操作，尽管 API 服务器已经接受了该 Pod。

sents.en: If the cancellation also cancels the caller’s cleanup, the pod becomes ready with nobody waiting for it, and a retry creates another pod; in a stress test, this path left at least 4,181 excess pods.
sents.zh: 如果取消操作同时也取消了调用方的清理，该 Pod 会在无人等待的情况下变为就绪，而重试会创建另一个 Pod；在压力测试中，这条路径留下了至少 4,181 个多余的 Pod。

sents.en: Table 2 lists this and two other ways a pod outlives its caller.
sents.zh: 表 2 列出了这种情况以及 Pod 比其调用方存活更久的另外两种方式。

sents.en: The provider therefore owns each create until it settles: the create runs even if its caller is cancelled, and cleanup runs on any exit, even a second cancellation.
sents.zh: 因此，提供者拥有每次创建操作直到其落定：即使调用方被取消，创建操作也会运行，并且清理在任何退出路径上都会运行，即使是第二次取消。

sents.en: The pool keeps the create of a timed-out acquire: a late pod without an agent label becomes a warm pod, and any other late pod is deleted.
sents.zh: 资源池会保留超时获取操作的创建：没有智能体标签的迟到 Pod 会成为温备 Pod，其他任何迟到的 Pod 则被删除。

sents.en: A nonce on each create lets the provider find and delete a pod that the API stored but answered with an error.
sents.zh: 每次创建操作上的随机数让提供者能够找到并删除已被 API 存储但返回了错误的 Pod。

sents.en: An unconfirmed delete is retried until the job drains; deletes pending when the provider’s event loop closes are lost, and the owner reference lets Kubernetes remove them.
sents.zh: 未确认的删除会一直重试直到任务排空；当提供者的事件循环关闭时仍未完成的删除会丢失，而属主引用让 Kubernetes 移除它们。

paragraphs.en: A timed-out command can leave children running. execd therefore kills each command’s process group on a timeout or reset and caps output while draining it. It also checks a command’s syntax before running it and accepts an exit status only in a complete frame.
paragraphs.zh: 超时的命令可能会留下仍在运行的子进程。因此 execd 在超时或重置时会终止每个命令的进程组，并在排空输出时限制输出量。 它还会在运行命令前检查命令的语法，并且只接受完整帧中的退出状态。

sents.en: A timed-out command can leave children running. execd therefore kills each command’s process group on a timeout or reset and caps output while draining it.
sents.zh: 超时的命令可能会留下仍在运行的子进程。因此 execd 在超时或重置时会终止每个命令的进程组，并在排空输出时限制输出量。

sents.en: It also checks a command’s syntax before running it and accepts an exit status only in a complete frame.
sents.zh: 它还会在运行命令前检查命令的语法，并且只接受完整帧中的退出状态。

paragraphs.en: Owning every create costs waiting and capacity. A cancelled caller waits for its create, and late warm pods hold capacity. Commands are sent once, since a timed-out one may have half-run; safe retries would need request deduplication in execd . We have no periodic sweep for ownerless labelled pods, which would catch unknown leaks.
paragraphs.zh: 拥有每一次创建都需要付出等待和容量成本。 已取消的调用方仍在等待其创建操作，而较晚预热的 Pod 会占用容量。 命令只发送一次，因为超时的命令可能已经执行了一半；安全的重试需要在 execd 中实现请求去重。 我们没有针对无属主标记 Pod 的定期清扫机制，而这一机制本可以发现未知的资源泄漏。

sents.en: Owning every create costs waiting and capacity.
sents.zh: 拥有每一次创建都需要付出等待和容量成本。

sents.en: A cancelled caller waits for its create, and late warm pods hold capacity.
sents.zh: 已取消的调用方仍在等待其创建操作，而较晚预热的 Pod 会占用容量。

sents.en: Commands are sent once, since a timed-out one may have half-run; safe retries would need request deduplication in execd .
sents.zh: 命令只发送一次，因为超时的命令可能已经执行了一半；安全的重试需要在 execd 中实现请求去重。

sents.en: We have no periodic sweep for ownerless labelled pods, which would catch unknown leaks.
sents.zh: 我们没有针对无属主标记 Pod 的定期清扫机制，而这一机制本可以发现未知的资源泄漏。

paragraphs.en: An edit must start from the exact bytes. The model may see a trimmed view of a file, but the editor reads whole files byte-exact because it writes them back. It checks each read’s length and SHA-256 and refuses files it cannot write back unchanged (not valid UTF-8, mixed line endings, a bare carriage return), telling the agent to use the shell instead.
paragraphs.zh: 编辑必须从精确的字节开始。 模型看到的可能是文件的截断视图，但编辑器按字节精确读取整个文件，因为它要把文件写回去。 它会检查每次读取的长度和 SHA-256，并拒绝无法原样写回的文件（不是有效的 UTF-8、混合的换行符、单独的回车符），同时告诉智能体改用 shell。

sents.en: An edit must start from the exact bytes.
sents.zh: 编辑必须从精确的字节开始。

sents.en: The model may see a trimmed view of a file, but the editor reads whole files byte-exact because it writes them back.
sents.zh: 模型看到的可能是文件的截断视图，但编辑器按字节精确读取整个文件，因为它要把文件写回去。

sents.en: It checks each read’s length and SHA-256 and refuses files it cannot write back unchanged (not valid UTF-8, mixed line endings, a bare carriage return), telling the agent to use the shell instead.
sents.zh: 它会检查每次读取的长度和 SHA-256，并拒绝无法原样写回的文件（不是有效的 UTF-8、混合的换行符、单独的回车符），同时告诉智能体改用 shell。

paragraphs.en: A patch holds only the agent’s change, and each task gets a reference/empty-patch preflight. An agent once planted a conftest.py that made the tests pass without a fix, so test-configuration files are left out of patches. The trainer resets the index to the task’s base commit, stages the agent’s changes and diffs, so the patch is the agent’s change against the baseline. The tests of two Verified tasks do not check the fix. Before a job starts, it grades each task’s reference patch (must pass) and an empty patch (must fail) under its own configuration and keeps only tasks passing both.
paragraphs.zh: 补丁仅包含智能体的改动，每个任务都会进行参考补丁/空补丁预检。 曾有智能体植入 conftest.py 使测试在没有修复的情况下通过，因此补丁中会排除测试配置文件。 训练器将索引重置到任务的基础提交，暂存智能体的改动并生成 diff，因此补丁就是智能体针对基线的改动。 两个 Verified 任务的测试并未检查修复。 在任务开始前，会在其自身配置下对每个任务的参考补丁（必须通过）和空补丁（必须失败）进行评分，只保留两项都通过的任务。

sents.en: A patch holds only the agent’s change, and each task gets a reference/empty-patch preflight.
sents.zh: 补丁仅包含智能体的改动，每个任务都会进行参考补丁/空补丁预检。

sents.en: An agent once planted a conftest.py that made the tests pass without a fix, so test-configuration files are left out of patches.
sents.zh: 曾有智能体植入 conftest.py 使测试在没有修复的情况下通过，因此补丁中会排除测试配置文件。

sents.en: The trainer resets the index to the task’s base commit, stages the agent’s changes and diffs, so the patch is the agent’s change against the baseline.
sents.zh: 训练器将索引重置到任务的基础提交，暂存智能体的改动并生成 diff，因此补丁就是智能体针对基线的改动。

sents.en: The tests of two Verified tasks do not check the fix.
sents.zh: 两个 Verified 任务的测试并未检查修复。

sents.en: Before a job starts, it grades each task’s reference patch (must pass) and an empty patch (must fail) under its own configuration and keeps only tasks passing both.
sents.zh: 在任务开始前，会在其自身配置下对每个任务的参考补丁（必须通过）和空补丁（必须失败）进行评分，只保留两项都通过的任务。

paragraphs.en: A verdict is only as valid as its run conditions. Each test suite runs in a separate grading pod, never-used by default, keeping the agent’s processes and files out of the grade. For each task we declare the conditions its verdict may depend on: image, outbound network, CPU quota, visible CPUs, memory limit, user, time zone, hash seed, time limit and test suite. Before every grading, an in-pod probe run under the tests’ CPU pin reads eight of these conditions, all but the image and the test suite, and refuses the pod if a readable field contradicts the job’s declaration. An unreadable field does not refuse the pod, so a passed probe does not prove the environment matches. The image and the test suite are set, not probed: the grading pod starts from the task’s image reference, which fixes one image only as a digest, and the official tests are restored from the base commit. A grading that fails for an infrastructure reason is retried and, if still without a verdict, resampled, never scored 0. Failing tests and patches that do not apply stay valid zeros.
paragraphs.zh: 判定结果的有效性取决于其运行条件。 每个测试套件都在一个独立的评分 pod 中运行，默认从不使用，从而将智能体的进程和文件排除在评分之外。 对于每个任务，我们声明其判定结果可能依赖的条件：镜像、出站网络、CPU 配额、可见 CPU、内存限制、用户、时区、哈希种子、时间限制和测试套件。 在每次评分之前，都会在测试的 CPU 绑定下运行一个 pod 内探针，读取其中八个条件（除镜像和测试套件之外的全部条件），如果某个可读字段与任务声明不符，则拒绝该 pod。 不可读的字段不会导致 pod 被拒绝，因此探针通过并不能证明环境匹配。 镜像和测试套件是被设置的，而非被探测的：评分 pod 从任务的镜像引用启动，该引用仅以摘要形式固定一个镜像，而官方测试则从基础提交恢复。 因基础设施原因而失败的评分会被重试，如果仍然没有判定结果，则重新采样，绝不会被计为 0 分。 失败的测试和无法应用的补丁仍然保持有效的 0 分。

sents.en: A verdict is only as valid as its run conditions.
sents.zh: 判定结果的有效性取决于其运行条件。

sents.en: Each test suite runs in a separate grading pod, never-used by default, keeping the agent’s processes and files out of the grade.
sents.zh: 每个测试套件都在一个独立的评分 pod 中运行，默认从不使用，从而将智能体的进程和文件排除在评分之外。

sents.en: For each task we declare the conditions its verdict may depend on: image, outbound network, CPU quota, visible CPUs, memory limit, user, time zone, hash seed, time limit and test suite.
sents.zh: 对于每个任务，我们声明其判定结果可能依赖的条件：镜像、出站网络、CPU 配额、可见 CPU、内存限制、用户、时区、哈希种子、时间限制和测试套件。

sents.en: Before every grading, an in-pod probe run under the tests’ CPU pin reads eight of these conditions, all but the image and the test suite, and refuses the pod if a readable field contradicts the job’s declaration.
sents.zh: 在每次评分之前，都会在测试的 CPU 绑定下运行一个 pod 内探针，读取其中八个条件（除镜像和测试套件之外的全部条件），如果某个可读字段与任务声明不符，则拒绝该 pod。

sents.en: An unreadable field does not refuse the pod, so a passed probe does not prove the environment matches.
sents.zh: 不可读的字段不会导致 pod 被拒绝，因此探针通过并不能证明环境匹配。

sents.en: The image and the test suite are set, not probed: the grading pod starts from the task’s image reference, which fixes one image only as a digest, and the official tests are restored from the base commit.
sents.zh: 镜像和测试套件是被设置的，而非被探测的：评分 pod 从任务的镜像引用启动，该引用仅以摘要形式固定一个镜像，而官方测试则从基础提交恢复。

sents.en: A grading that fails for an infrastructure reason is retried and, if still without a verdict, resampled, never scored 0.
sents.zh: 因基础设施原因而失败的评分会被重试，如果仍然没有判定结果，则重新采样，绝不会被计为 0 分。

sents.en: Failing tests and patches that do not apply stay valid zeros.
sents.zh: 失败的测试和无法应用的补丁仍然保持有效的 0 分。

paragraphs.en: The checks cost pod-hours and miss agent-specific effects. The reference/empty-patch check costs 0.06–0.14 pod-hours per task at the job’s configuration and sees no agent patch.
paragraphs.zh: 这些检查会消耗 Pod 小时，并且会遗漏智能体特有的影响。 在该作业的配置下，参照/空补丁检查每个任务消耗 0.06–0.14 Pod 小时，且看不到智能体的补丁。

sents.en: The checks cost pod-hours and miss agent-specific effects.

paragraphs.en: An outbound guard does not authenticate callers. Earlier deployments blocked outbound traffic from some sandboxes, but their endpoints stayed reachable without authentication from other pods: a live check from an unrelated pod invoked commands in guarded sandboxes. Pod addresses are routable cluster-wide, and a call into a grading pod could change its files and so a reward. execd checks a per-sandbox token on every call but health checks (Table 3 ). A network policy that the cluster applies by label and the network plugin enforces denies sandbox egress and admits only the trainer’s pods to execd ’s port. In-pod rules that the execd container cannot change stay as a second guard.
paragraphs.zh: 出站防护不会对调用方进行身份验证。 早期部署会阻止部分沙箱的出站流量，但其端点在其他 Pod 无需身份验证的情况下仍可被访问：一次来自无关 Pod 的存活检查在受防护的沙箱中调用了命令。 Pod 地址在整个集群内可路由，而进入评分 Pod 的调用可以更改其文件，从而改变奖励。execd 在每次调用时检查每个沙箱的令牌，但健康检查除外（表 3）。 由集群按标签应用并由网络插件强制执行的网络策略会拒绝沙箱的出站流量，并且仅允许训练器的 Pod 访问 execd 的端口。 execd 容器无法更改的 Pod 内规则作为第二道防护保留下来。

sents.zh: 出站防护不会对调用方进行身份验证。

paragraphs.en: A label alone is not enforcement. In one live check, 6 of 6 pods labelled egress-denied reached the internet, because only a patched provider installed the guard. The provider refuses an egress-denied label unless it installs the guard.
paragraphs.zh: 仅靠标签并不能实现强制执行。 在一次实际检测中，6 个带有 egress-denied 标签的 Pod 中有 6 个成功访问了互联网，因为只有打过补丁的提供方才会安装防护。 提供方拒绝接受 egress-denied 标签，除非它安装该防护。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Sandman in production and in controlled experiments: its use and cost, creation at scale, prewarming and reuse, and how sandbox waits reach training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在生产环境和受控实验中对 Sandman 进行评估：其使用与成本、大规模创建、预热与复用，以及沙箱等待如何传导至训练。

paragraphs.en: The studied SWE runs use Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with asynchronous GRPO, most on 16 B200 GPUs. Eight GPUs serve the learner and eight host SGLang inference engines (32 and 32 in the 64-GPU campaign), with eight samples per task. Rollout workers keep a fixed number of trajectories in flight. Each learner step consumes the next complete, graded groups (four groups of eight in most runs), and weights go to the engines after every step while generation continues. A trajectory has a 30-minute limit and 300 s per command; a test-suite run has 1,800 s. Unless stated otherwise, a sandbox requests 2 vCPUs and 8 GiB, requests equal to limits; the scale ramp used tiny pods. The controlled experiments include a scale ramp, a placement contrast, warm-pool and reuse A/Bs, a grading-condition study and a pre-registered comparison (Table A1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 所研究的SWE运行使用Qwen3.5-35B-A3B配合异步GRPO，大多在16块B200 GPU上进行。 八块GPU用于学习器，八块用于运行SGLang推理引擎（64-GPU规模时为32和32），每个任务八个样本。 Rollout工作进程保持固定数量的轨迹在途进行。 学习器的每一步消耗下一批完整且已评分的组（多数运行中为四组各八条），且每一步之后权重都会发送到推理引擎，同时生成仍在继续。 每条轨迹有30分钟的时间上限，每条命令限时300秒；测试套件运行限时1,800秒。 除非另有说明，沙盒请求2个vCPU和8 GiB内存，请求量等于上限；规模爬坡实验使用了微型Pod。 受控实验包括规模爬坡、放置位置对比、预热池与复用的A/B测试、评分条件研究以及一项预注册对比（表A1）。

paragraphs.en: Each result names its evidence kind. Production results come from the campaigns’ and other jobs’ logs, run records and the API audit log. Controlled experiments are dedicated runs on the shared cluster. Replays run recorded traces through the real pool code or a packing model, and reproductions use a few pods or a local copy to show that a failure path exists, not how often. Create-to-Ready ends at Ready status; the waiting share is acquisition over trajectory time. CIs are 95% t t -intervals over run pairs unless named (Wilson for proportions), and A/B arms ran concurrently. Table 4 shows which key mechanisms each kind of evidence ran.
paragraphs.zh: 每个结果都会标明其证据类型。 生产结果来自营销活动和其他任务的日志、运行记录以及 API 审计日志。 受控实验是在共享集群上进行的专用运行。 重放是将记录的轨迹通过真实的资源池代码或打包模型运行，而复现则使用少量 pod 或本地副本，以表明某条失败路径存在，而非其发生频率。 从创建到 Ready 的时长以达到 Ready 状态为终点；等待占比是沿时间轨迹计算的获取时长。 置信区间默认为基于运行配对的 95% t 区间，除非另有标注（比例采用 Wilson 区间），且 A/B 各组是并发运行的。 表 4 展示了每类证据验证了哪些关键机制。

paragraphs.en: Four SWE campaigns created 3.13 million sandboxes in two weeks. From 3 to 17 October, these campaigns ran 122 training runs on about 21,400 B200-hours. They created 1.24M rollout and 1.89M grading sandboxes at 1.8–6.3 creates per second on average per campaign, with up to 27 runs (432 GPUs) and at most 1,728 trajectories in flight at once. Rollout sandboxes lived 136–207 s at the median and 424–457 s at p99 (Table A2 ). From late July to mid-October, about ten other users ran at least 299 jobs, up to 896 GPUs each.
paragraphs.zh: 四次 SWE 战役在两周内创建了 313 万个沙箱。 从 10 月 3 日到 17 日，这些战役在约 21,400 个 B200 小时上运行了 122 次训练运行。 它们以每秒平均 1.8–6.3 次创建的速度（按每次战役平均计算）创建了 124 万个 rollout 沙箱和 189 万个评分沙箱，最多同时有 27 个运行（432 块 GPU）和最多 1,728 条轨迹在途。 rollout 沙箱的中位存活时间为 136–207 秒，p99 为 424–457 秒（表 A2）。 从 7 月下旬到 10 月中旬，约十名其他用户运行了至少 299 个作业，每个作业最多使用 896 块 GPU。

paragraphs.en: Most attempts got a sandbox; failures clustered in webhook incidents. Between 99.73% (A) and 91.16% (C) of attempts got a working sandbox. In C, 99.5% of failures were rejections by unreachable admission webhooks, and after one retry at least 96.69% of trajectories had a sandbox (Table A5 ). In D, 69.5% of attempts got a pod: in 12 runs during the 14 October incidents, bursts of agent-backend errors associated with webhook failures were retried as new starts. D’s other 27 runs reached 99.7%. In A–C, 33 of 576,666 attempts could not reach execd in time.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数尝试都获得了沙箱；失败集中在 webhook 事故中。 在 99.73%（A）到 91.16%（C）之间的尝试获得了可用的沙箱。 在 C 中，99.5% 的失败是无法连接的准入 webhook 的拒绝，重试一次后至少 96.69% 的轨迹获得了沙箱（表 A5）。 在 D 中，69.5% 的尝试获得了 pod：在 10 月 14 日事故期间的 12 次运行中，与 webhook 故障相关的智能体后端错误爆发被作为新的启动进行了重试。 D 的其余 27 次运行达到了 99.7%。 在 A–C 中，576,666 次尝试中有 33 次未能及时连接到 execd。

paragraphs.en: Sandboxes cost 1.7–3.5% of the GPU cost. Campaigns A–C held 3.30–3.75 sandbox-hours per B200 GPU-hour. At on-demand list prices, that is about 1.7% of the GPU cost if a sandbox is charged its node share of CPU and 3.5% if charged its share of memory, or 1.8–3.7% with test re-runs and evaluation jobs. Requests, not use, set this cost: 198 sampled sandbox pods of all users used 10.5% of their CPU and 1.9% of their memory requests, by pod-minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 沙盒的成本占 GPU 成本的 1.7–3.5%。 活动 A–C 中，每 B200 GPU 小时对应 3.30–3.75 个沙盒小时。 按按需标价计算，如果沙盒按其节点分摊的 CPU 计费，这约占 GPU 成本的 1.7%；如果按其分摊的内存计费，则约为 3.5%；若计入测试重跑和评估任务，则为 1.8–3.7%。 这一成本由请求而非实际使用决定：按 pod 分钟计算，采样的 198 个所有用户的沙盒 pod 仅使用了其请求 CPU 的 10.5% 和请求内存的 1.9%。

paragraphs.en: The control path held 11,858 concurrent tiny sandboxes. A ramp of the real pool and provider to 12,000 requested sandboxes, paced at 20–25 creates per second, kept create-to-Ready at a 5–7 s median (Figure 3 a). The ramp met no admission error in 38,377 creates, including a sweep of 5–200 creates per second, and we stopped at 12,000 to keep subnet headroom. The pods were tiny (0.1 vCPU, 128 MiB, a cached 43 MB image), so the ramp shows what the control path held at this rate, not sustained churn. Most of their 5–7 s was our readiness detection and execd starting under the tiny quota; with 2 vCPUs, create-to-Ready took 2 s.
paragraphs.zh: 控制路径承载了 11,858 个并发微型沙箱。 将真实资源池和提供商逐步提升至请求 12,000 个沙箱，以每秒 20–25 个创建的速度进行，创建到 Ready 的中位时间保持在 5–7 秒（图 3 a）。 该提升过程在 38,377 次创建中没有出现任何准入错误，其中包括每秒 5–200 次创建的扫描测试；我们在 12,000 处停止，以保留子网余量。 这些 Pod 很小（0.1 vCPU、128 MiB、43 MB 的缓存镜像），因此该提升过程展示的是控制路径在此速率下的承载能力，而非持续的动态变更。 其中 5–7 秒的大部分时间是我们对就绪状态的检测以及 execd 在极小配额下的启动；在 2 个 vCPU 下，创建到 Ready 只需 2 秒。

sents.zh: 控制路径承载了 11,858 个并发微型沙箱。

sents.en: The ramp met no admission error in 38,377 creates, including a sweep of 5–200 creates per second, and we stopped at 12,000 to keep subnet headroom.
sents.zh: 该提升过程在 38,377 次创建中没有出现任何准入错误，其中包括每秒 5–200 次创建的扫描测试；我们在 12,000 处停止，以保留子网余量。

sents.zh: 其中 5–7 秒的大部分时间是我们对就绪状态的检测以及 execd 在极小配额下的启动；在 2 个 vCPU 下，创建到 Ready 只需 2 秒。

paragraphs.en: The tail came with pod-address failures, more often on crowded nodes. During a 2.2-hour window, 5–39% of each step’s pods first failed to get an address and retried, which pushed p99 to 21–102 s. Every step of the initial ascending ramp above 99 sandboxes fell inside this window, so the ramp cannot separate size from the address failures. In a follow-up ramp, pods on nodes that received 20 or more of a step’s pods failed their first assignment 31–55% of the time, against 0–16% on nodes with fewer than 10. In one production hour, 0.64% of creates did.
paragraphs.zh: 尾部延迟伴随 pod 地址分配失败而来，且在拥挤节点上更常见。 在一个 2.2 小时的时间窗口内，每一步的 pod 中有 5–39% 首次获取地址失败并重试，这把 p99 推高到 21–102 秒。 超过 99 个沙盒的初始上升爬坡的每一步都落在这个窗口内，因此该爬坡无法将规模与地址失败分离开来。 在后续的一次爬坡中，接收到某一步 20 个或更多 pod 的节点上的 pod 首次分配失败的比例为 31–55%，而 pod 数少于 10 个的节点上这一比例仅为 0–16%。 在一个生产小时中，0.64% 的创建操作出现了这种情况。

sents.en: The tail came with pod-address failures, more often on crowded nodes.
sents.zh: 尾部延迟伴随 pod 地址分配失败而来，且在拥挤节点上更常见。

paragraphs.en: With spreading, a 1,000-pod batch had no address failures. Two batches of 1,000 tiny sandboxes ran three minutes apart on the same 375 nodes, both paced at 10 per second: first spread (at most 3 pods per node), then default-scheduled (up to 65). The default batch had 254 first-attempt address failures, all later Ready. Create-to-Ready p99 was 8 s with spreading and 57 s without, although the default batch found the image cached on every node (Figure 3 b). Callers’ median wait from submission (56 and 62 s) was mostly our pacer queue. Other workloads’ failures rose during the default batch and stayed high after our pods left, so a change over time confounds the comparison, and a pre-registered stop rule ended the experiment. This is one sequential pair, and spreading was seen only up to 8 pods per node.
paragraphs.zh: 通过分散部署，1,000 个 Pod 的批次没有出现任何地址故障。 两批各 1,000 个微型沙箱在同一批 375 个节点上间隔三分钟运行，均以每秒 10 个的节奏进行：先采用分散部署（每个节点最多 3 个 Pod），再采用默认调度（最多 65 个）。 默认批次出现了 254 次首次尝试的地址故障，但后来全部达到 Ready 状态。 从创建到 Ready 的 p99 在使用分散部署时为 8 秒，不使用时为 57 秒，尽管默认批次发现镜像已缓存于每个节点（图 3 b）。 调用方从提交算起的中位等待时间（56 秒和 62 秒）主要来自我们的节奏器队列。 在默认批次运行期间，其他工作负载的故障率上升，并且在我们的 Pod 离开后仍保持高位，因此随时间变化的因素干扰了这一对比，预注册的停止规则终止了该实验。 这是一个顺序执行的成对实验，且分散部署仅在每节点最多 8 个 Pod 的范围内被观察到。

sents.zh: 通过分散部署，1,000 个 Pod 的批次没有出现任何地址故障。

sents.en: Two batches of 1,000 tiny sandboxes ran three minutes apart on the same 375 nodes, both paced at 10 per second: first spread (at most 3 pods per node), then default-scheduled (up to 65).

sents.zh: 调用方从提交算起的中位等待时间（56 秒和 62 秒）主要来自我们的节奏器队列。

sents.en: Other workloads’ failures rose during the default batch and stayed high after our pods left, so a change over time confounds the comparison, and a pre-registered stop rule ended the experiment.
sents.zh: 在默认批次运行期间，其他工作负载的故障率上升，并且在我们的 Pod 离开后仍保持高位，因此随时间变化的因素干扰了这一对比，预注册的停止规则终止了该实验。

sents.en: This is one sequential pair, and spreading was seen only up to 8 pods per node.
sents.zh: 这是一个顺序执行的成对实验，且分散部署仅在每节点最多 8 个 Pod 的范围内被观察到。

paragraphs.en: Pulling an image quadrupled the median create. In a re-grading study on SWE-Gym images of 1.3–8.4 GB, a create that had to pull took 17.4 s at the median (p90 74.3 s, 422 pods). With the image on the node, a create took 4.1 s (p90 5.1 s, 230 pods), compared within each image, node and half hour (Figure 4 a; Table A16 ). The cost grew with image size. We could not measure how often production creates pulled. Slow pulls also became failures: a fixed 120 s readiness budget that included the pull rejected 9 admissible tasks of a 280-task set, hence the per-job budget.
paragraphs.zh: 拉取镜像使中位创建时间翻了两番。 在一项针对 1.3–8.4 GB 的 SWE-Gym 镜像的重新评分研究中，需要拉取镜像的创建操作中位数耗时 17.4 秒（p90 为 74.3 秒，422 个 Pod）。 当节点上已有镜像时，创建操作耗时 4.1 秒（p90 为 5.1 秒，230 个 Pod），该对比在同一镜像、同一节点和同一半小时内进行（图 4a；表 A16）。 这一开销随镜像大小增长。 我们无法测量生产环境中创建操作拉取镜像的频率。 慢速拉取还会导致失败：一个包含拉取时间的固定 120 秒就绪预算，在 280 个任务的集合中拒绝了 9 个可采纳的任务，因此采用了按作业划分的预算。

sents.en: Pulling an image quadrupled the median create.
sents.zh: 拉取镜像使中位创建时间翻了两番。

sents.zh: 在一项针对 1.3–8.4 GB 的 SWE-Gym 镜像的重新评分研究中，需要拉取镜像的创建操作中位数耗时 17.4 秒（p90 为 74.3 秒，422 个 Pod）。

sents.zh: 当节点上已有镜像时，创建操作耗时 4.1 秒（p90 为 5.1 秒，230 个 Pod），该对比在同一镜像、同一节点和同一半小时内进行（图 4a；表 A16）。

sents.zh: 这一开销随镜像大小增长。

sents.zh: 我们无法测量生产环境中创建操作拉取镜像的频率。

sents.en: Slow pulls also became failures: a fixed 120 s readiness budget that included the pull rejected 9 admissible tasks of a 280-task set, hence the per-job budget.
sents.zh: 慢速拉取还会导致失败：一个包含拉取时间的固定 120 秒就绪预算，在 280 个任务的集合中拒绝了 9 个可采纳的任务，因此采用了按作业划分的预算。

paragraphs.en: A warm pool cut grading acquisition 50-fold but more than doubled sandbox vCPU-hours. Three pairs of concurrent 16-GPU runs differed only in whether grading sandboxes came from the pool. The pool served 93–96% of gradings warm and cut grading acquisition from 6.2 s to 0.12 s (means of per-run medians); the waiting share fell from 7.0% to 4.2% (Figure 4 b). A warm pod is still created and then idles on its full request. At a 2,100 s idle timeout, longer than a run’s 27-minute cycle through its 88 images, pool-on runs used 2.46 × \times the pool-off runs’ sandbox vCPU-hours, mostly in idle warm pods. In replays, which overstated hits at 2,100 s by 1.8–3.5 points, a 300 s timeout kept the warm-hit rate at 94.5–97.7% at about half the idle cost (Figure 4 c).
paragraphs.zh: 温池将评分获取时间缩短了50倍，但使沙箱vCPU小时数增加了一倍以上。 三对并发的16-GPU运行唯一的区别在于评分沙箱是否来自池。 该池以温状态服务了93–96%的评分，并将评分获取时间从6.2秒降至0.12秒（各次运行中位数的均值）；等待占比从7.0%降至4.2%（图4b）。 温Pod仍会被创建，然后在其完整请求上闲置。 在2,100秒的闲置超时下——长于一次运行遍历其88张图像的27分钟周期——开启池的运行使用了池关闭运行2.46 × \times倍的沙箱vCPU小时数，主要消耗在闲置的温Pod上。 在重放中（其将2,100秒时的命中率高估了1.8–3.5个百分点），300秒的超时在约为闲置成本一半的情况下，将温命中率保持在94.5–97.7%（图4c）。

sents.zh: 温池将评分获取时间缩短了50倍，但使沙箱vCPU小时数增加了一倍以上。

sents.en: Three pairs of concurrent 16-GPU runs differed only in whether grading sandboxes came from the pool.
sents.zh: 三对并发的16-GPU运行唯一的区别在于评分沙箱是否来自池。

sents.zh: 该池以温状态服务了93–96%的评分，并将评分获取时间从6.2秒降至0.12秒（各次运行中位数的均值）；等待占比从7.0%降至4.2%（图4b）。

sents.zh: 在重放中（其将2,100秒时的命中率高估了1.8–3.5个百分点），300秒的超时在约为闲置成本一半的情况下，将温命中率保持在94.5–97.7%（图4c）。

paragraphs.en: The warm pool shortened time to step 24 by 9.4%. Pool-on runs reached step 24 sooner in all three pairs (95% CI 5.9–13.0%), in two of the three mostly in the first step. The steady-state effect is unresolved: the mean step interval over steps 2–24 differed by − - 8.7 s (95% CI − - 38.4 to + + 21.0), and three pairs detect only changes above 24% of the step interval (80% power, α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 ). These runs do not attribute the gain to faster acquisition.
paragraphs.zh: 预热池使达到第 24 步的时间缩短了 9.4%。 在所有三组对比中，开启池的运行都更早达到第 24 步（95% CI 为 5.9–13.0%），其中三组中的两组主要在第一步就体现出优势。 稳态效应尚无定论：第 2–24 步的平均步进间隔差异为 − - 8.7 秒（95% CI 为 − - 38.4 到 + + 21.0），且三组对比只能在步进间隔变化超过 24% 时才可检测到（80% 检验效能，α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05）。 这些运行并未将该收益归因于更快的采集。

sents.zh: 预热池使达到第 24 步的时间缩短了 9.4%。

paragraphs.en: Reuse cut creates against a warm pool, but on demand used fewer pod-hours. Checked reuse cut creates per grading by 29% against a warm pool (95% CI 22–36%), and reused pods served 34–43% of gradings. In the pre-registered configuration (§ 5.4 ), reuse made 1.21 creates per grading against 1.00 on demand, and on demand used the fewest pod-hours in all eight replayed traces. The state check took 0.23–0.51 s at the median, off the grading path. Fallback rates depended on the graders: 8 of 64,199 checks on Verified task sets moved the grading to a fresh pod, against 23.7% on SWE-Gym, whose graders rebuild artifacts. In the pre-registered comparison, whose grading change used the pool with reuse, warm and reused hits took about 12 ms. Queue-inclusive acquisition averaged 20.3 s, against 7.2 s with direct creation: the pool built pods at 0.3 creates per second under a 32-pod cap, so over half the requests waited for its creates. In this configuration queueing offset the fast hits, and acquisition took 13% of step time against 4.5% with direct creation.
paragraphs.zh: 相比温池，复用减少了创建次数，但按需模式使用的 pod 小时数更少。 相比温池，复用将每次评分的创建次数降低了 29%（95% 置信区间为 22–36%），且复用的 pod 承担了 34–43% 的评分任务。 在预注册配置（§ 5.4）中，复用模式下每次评分为 1.21 次创建，而按需模式为 1.00 次，且按需模式在全部八个重放轨迹中使用的 pod 小时数最少。 状态检查的中位耗时为 0.23–0.51 秒，且不在评分路径上。 回退率取决于评分器：在 Verified 任务集的 64,199 次检查中，有 8 次将评分转移到全新的 pod，而在 SWE-Gym 上这一比例为 23.7%，因为其评分器需要重建工件。 在预注册比较中（其评分变更使用带复用的池），温命中和复用命中耗时约 12 毫秒。 含排队等待的获取平均耗时 20.3 秒，而直接创建为 7.2 秒：该池在 32 个 pod 的上限下以每秒 0.3 次创建的速度构建 pod，因此超过一半的请求需要等待其创建。 在此配置中，排队抵消了快速命中的优势，获取占步骤时间的 13%，而直接创建为 4.5%。

sents.en: Reuse cut creates against a warm pool, but on demand used fewer pod-hours.
sents.zh: 相比温池，复用减少了创建次数，但按需模式使用的 pod 小时数更少。

sents.en: Checked reuse cut creates per grading by 29% against a warm pool (95% CI 22–36%), and reused pods served 34–43% of gradings.

sents.en: In the pre-registered configuration (§ 5.4 ), reuse made 1.21 creates per grading against 1.00 on demand, and on demand used the fewest pod-hours in all eight replayed traces.
sents.zh: 在预注册配置（§ 5.4）中，复用模式下每次评分为 1.21 次创建，而按需模式为 1.00 次，且按需模式在全部八个重放轨迹中使用的 pod 小时数最少。

sents.zh: 在预注册比较中（其评分变更使用带复用的池），温命中和复用命中耗时约 12 毫秒。

sents.en: Queue-inclusive acquisition averaged 20.3 s, against 7.2 s with direct creation: the pool built pods at 0.3 creates per second under a 32-pod cap, so over half the requests waited for its creates.
sents.zh: 含排队等待的获取平均耗时 20.3 秒，而直接创建为 7.2 秒：该池在 32 个 pod 的上限下以每秒 0.3 次创建的速度构建 pod，因此超过一半的请求需要等待其创建。

sents.en: In this configuration queueing offset the fast hits, and acquisition took 13% of step time against 4.5% with direct creation.
sents.zh: 在此配置中，排队抵消了快速命中的优势，获取占步骤时间的 13%，而直接创建为 4.5%。

paragraphs.en: Of sandbox time, grading acquisition and tests, not rollout acquisition, lay on the critical path. Most runs were generation-bound: in A–C the learner waited for data during 65–78% of each step, and in most traced runs 97–100% of in-flight slots were busy (88–96% in the partly learner-bound pool A/B). We traced 3,734 learner steps of campaign A and three controlled experiments to the trajectory that ended each wait, which lies on the step’s critical path (Figure 5 ; Appendix J ). Rollout acquisition took at most 0.9% of step time on this path, since other trajectories’ work overlaps it. Outside incidents and test re-runs, the end of the slowest trajectory was on the critical path, through grading acquisition (4.5–6.8% with fresh pods, 1–2% with the A/Bs’ warm pools) and tests (8–11% with one suite, 38% with two).
paragraphs.zh: 在沙盒时间中，处于关键路径上的是评分获取和测试，而非轨迹采集。 大多数运行受生成阶段限制：在 A–C 中，学习器在每一步有 65–78% 的时间在等待数据，且在大多数被追踪的运行中，97–100% 的在途槽位处于忙碌状态（在部分受学习器限制的资源池 A/B 中为 88–96%）。 我们追踪了任务 A 的 3,734 个学习器步骤以及三个受控实验，直到结束每次等待的那条轨迹，该轨迹位于该步骤的关键路径上（图 5；附录 J）。 在此路径上，轨迹采集最多只占步骤时间的 0.9%，因为其他轨迹的工作与其重叠。 除外部事故和测试重跑外，最慢轨迹的结束点位于关键路径上，途经评分获取（使用新资源池时占 4.5–6.8%，使用 A/B 的预热资源池时占 1–2%）和测试（使用一个测试套件时占 8–11%，使用两个时占 38%）。

paragraphs.en: A fixed-concurrency model estimates the potential benefit of faster sandboxes. If a run stays generation-bound and generation does not slow down, removing a fraction f f of trajectory time shortens the step interval by about f f . Little’s law matched every measured mean step interval within 3% (Appendix J ). Counting acquisition, failed attempts’ slot time and test re-run creates, the model estimates a 6–14% shorter step per campaign (1,800 of 21,400 B200-hours) and 3–5% for the warm pool; neither is measured.
paragraphs.zh: 固定并发模型估算了更快的沙箱可能带来的收益。 如果一次运行始终保持受生成限制且生成速度没有变慢，移除比例为 f f 的轨迹时间会使步进间隔缩短约 f f。 利特尔定律（Little's law）与每一次实测的平均步进间隔的误差在 3% 以内（附录 J）。 将获取、失败尝试占用的槽位时间以及测试重跑计入后，该模型估算每次战役（campaign）的步进时间缩短 6–14%（2.14 万 B200-小时中的 1,800 小时），暖池（warm pool）则为 3–5%；两者均未经实测验证。

paragraphs.en: Changing one run condition at a time changed at most 12 of 11,399 verdicts on a robust task set. Re-grading pair 1 of both A/Bs on fresh pods, with one of six conditions changed at a time, changed no verdict beyond repeat noise, and a non-root user changed 12 verdicts (0.1%; Appendix H ). That set held no condition-dependent task.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个稳健的任务集上，每次改变一个运行条件，最多只改变了 11,399 个判定中的 12 个。 在全新的 pod 上对两组 A/B 的第 1 对进行重新评分，每次改变六个条件中的一个，判定结果的变化均未超出重复噪声范围，而以非 root 用户运行改变了 12 个判定（0.1%；附录 H）。 该集合不包含任何依赖条件的任务。

paragraphs.en: In the one pre-registered training comparison, the arm with the grading change resolved fewer held-out tasks. Six pairs of 150-step runs with campaign D’s recipe compared an arm with a combined grading change against one without. The change dropped the three tasks that the reference/empty-patch check flagged, graded through the warm pool with checked reuse, and required the execd token on pooled grading pods. On 112 held-out tasks, resolve rates after training were 46.1% with the change and 48.4% without (26.1% for the base model). Over all six pairs, as registered, the difference was − - 2.33 points (95% CI − - 4.22 to − - 0.43; Appendix K ). The change altered three things at once, so the design cannot isolate a cause. Post hoc, its arm trained on 3.4% fewer tasks, two of them tasks whose tests reward any non-empty patch, so it also lost easy reward.
paragraphs.zh: 在唯一一项预注册的训练对比中，包含评分变更的一组解决的留出任务更少。 六对 150 步的运行采用活动 D 的配方，将包含组合评分变更的一组与不包含的一组进行比较。 该变更删除了参考/空补丁检查标记的三个任务，通过带复用检查的预热池进行评分，并要求在池化评分节点上使用 execd 令牌。 在 112 个留出任务上，训练后的解决率为：包含该变更的一组为 46.1%，不包含的一组为 48.4%（基础模型为 26.1%）。 如注册所述，在全部六对中，差异为 −2.33 个百分点（95% 置信区间 −4.22 至 −0.43；附录 K）。 该变更同时改变了三件事，因此该设计无法分离出原因。 事后分析显示，其所在组训练的任务少了 3.4%，其中两个任务的测试会奖励任何非空补丁，因此它也失去了容易获得的奖励。

paragraphs.en: We draw seven lessons from operating Sandman.
paragraphs.zh: 从运营 Sandman 的过程中，我们总结出七条经验教训。

paragraphs.en: Judge a faster start by training progress and cost. With dozens of trajectories in flight, one sandbox wait overlaps others’ work. In the observed schedules outside incidents, grading acquisition dominated sandbox waiting on the last-completing trajectories. This attribution does not by itself measure the throughput benefit of faster rollout acquisition, which can also release in-flight slots earlier. Report acquisition with the caller’s queueing included, and weigh a warm pool’s hit rate against its idle pods (§ 5.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 通过训练进度和成本来判断更快的启动。 当有数十条轨迹在执行时，一个沙箱的等待可以与其他工作重叠。 在观测到的非事故调度中，评分获取在最后完成的轨迹上占主导地位，超过了沙箱等待。 这种归因本身并不能衡量更快 rollout 获取所带来的吞吐量收益，因为后者还能更早释放执行中的槽位。 报告获取时间时应包含调用方的排队时间，并将热池的命中率与其空闲 pod 进行权衡（§ 5.3）。

paragraphs.en: Plan for create bursts, not only live sandboxes. On 14 October, an evaluation with 4,096 concurrent trajectories created sandboxes without pacing. The cluster’s policy admission webhook ran one replica with a 384 MiB limit and had restarted 115 times since early September. The webhook answered pod creates with errors: 84.9% of the evaluation’s 6,144 trajectories failed, and so did 6,126 creates of other jobs. The cause was the webhook’s configuration, and our burst was the trigger. The webhook runs three 1 GiB replicas on separate nodes with a disruption budget, and our SWE jobs pace creates through the pool. The scale ramp’s 38,377 paced creates later met no admission error, which is consistent with the fix but does not prove it. Pacing across a job’s workers needs the shared pool, and aggregate pressure still depends on concurrent jobs and other cluster workloads.
paragraphs.zh: 为创建突发做准备，而不仅仅针对运行中的沙箱。 在 10 月 14 日，一次包含 4,096 条并发轨迹的评估在无节流的情况下创建沙箱。 集群的策略准入 webhook 以单副本运行，内存限制为 384 MiB，且自 9 月初以来已重启 115 次。 该 webhook 对 pod 创建请求返回错误：评估的 6,144 条轨迹中有 84.9% 失败，其他任务的 6,126 次创建也同样失败。 原因在于 webhook 的配置，而我们的突发流量是触发因素。 现在 webhook 在不同节点上运行三个 1 GiB 副本并配置了中断预算，我们的 SWE 任务通过池对创建请求进行节流。 规模爬坡期间后来的 38,377 次节流创建未再遇到准入错误，这与修复措施一致，但并不能证明是修复所致。 跨任务 worker 的节流需要共享池，而总体压力仍取决于并发任务和集群中的其他工作负载。

paragraphs.en: Turn off Service links. On 10 October, the namespace held 3,255 Services, mostly another team’s, and Kubernetes put about 23,400 of their variables into every new container. In campaign A (3–4 October), as Services accumulated, the median bash call slowed from 0.63 to 2.12 s. With Service links off, a production smoke test’s median bash call took 16–22 ms. With Service creates unpaced, 241 of 1,000 sandboxes failed in a Service-routing test, 237 of them on throttled Service creates.
paragraphs.zh: 关闭 Service 链接。 10 月 10 日，该命名空间中有 3,255 个 Service，其中大多数属于另一个团队，Kubernetes 会把约 23,400 个相关变量注入每个新建容器。 在活动 A（10 月 3–4 日）中，随着 Service 不断累积，bash 调用的中位耗时从 0.63 秒升至 2.12 秒。 关闭 Service 链接后，一次生产环境冒烟测试中 bash 调用的中位耗时为 16–22 毫秒。 在不加节流地创建 Service 的情况下，1,000 个沙箱中有 241 个在 Service 路由测试中失败，其中 237 个失败源于被限流的 Service 创建操作。

paragraphs.en: Select the whole node pool and watch free addresses. Workers pinned to one instance type found its 115 nodes full of other tenants’ pods; 9 jobs started only after selecting the pool’s label. During our ramp, free pod addresses fell from 33.6k to 26.5k at 12,000 sandboxes; the tightest subnet is shared with the GPU nodes, so we stopped there.
paragraphs.zh: 选择整个节点池并观察空闲地址。 固定在一种实例类型上的工作节点，其 115 个节点已被其他租户的 Pod 占满；在选中该节点池的标签后，9 个作业才得以启动。 在我们的爬坡过程中，空闲 Pod 地址从 33.6k 降至 26.5k（此时有 12,000 个沙箱）；最紧张的子网与 GPU 节点共享，因此我们到此为止。

paragraphs.en: Keep cleanup with the provider once a create is submitted. In a stress test, acquire timeouts cancelled creates that the API server had already stored. Of 13,516 rollout pods, 5,904 were removed only by garbage collection at teardown; the leaks filled the job’s node type. With the provider owning each create, no tested failure left an unowned pod: Table 2 ’s 24 windows and a name conflict, 20 repeats each, on a stand-in API, and 25 of 25 cluster trials.

paragraphs.en: Most recorded cases had a root in our own implementation. Eight lay in cluster configuration or a shared service alone; 10 had other or unknown causes. The ten cases with a GPU-hour account have upper bounds totaling 7.1–7.8k B200-hours; at most 0.47k fell in the campaigns’ 21.4k (2.2%), and the rest hit a stress test, an evaluation and an extension of campaign D (Table A49 ). paragraphs.en: Limitations. We studied one shared EKS cluster. The detailed training measurements cover SWE-bench-style Python tasks and one agent harness; reproductions and stand-in-API tests ran on one host. The ramp used tiny pods, each A/B has three pairs, replays hold trajectory timelines fixed, incident losses are upper bounds, and the security checks are live probes of our own sandboxes, not adversarial tests. Runs drew on 21–306 images with 48–256 trajectories in flight and a fully asynchronous trainer; many more images or a synchronous trainer may change the pool and critical-path results. We have no dedicated-cluster baseline and no internal measurements of the webhooks or the network plugin.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 我们研究了一个共享的 EKS 集群。 详细的训练测量涵盖了 SWE-bench 风格的 Python 任务和一种智能体框架；复现与替代 API 测试是在单台主机上运行的。 上坡阶段使用了极小的 Pod，每次 A/B 有三对，重放固定了轨迹时间线，事故损失为上界，且安全检查是对我们自己的沙箱的实时探测，而非对抗性测试。 运行涉及 21–306 个镜像、48–256 条在途轨迹以及完全异步的训练器；更多镜像或同步训练器可能改变资源池和关键路径结果。 我们没有专用集群的基线，也没有关于 webhook 或网络插件的内部测量。

paragraphs.en: Sandman turns task images into stateful sandboxes that training jobs acquire, use across tool calls and release, as ordinary pods on a shared cluster. Incidents, stress tests and studies showed what such a service must handle: paced and spread creates, provider-owned cleanup and gradings checked against declared run conditions. A faster start should be judged by time to a training step and by its cost.
paragraphs.zh: Sandman 将任务镜像转换为有状态的沙箱，训练作业以共享集群上普通 Pod 的方式获取、跨工具调用使用并释放这些沙箱。 故障事件、压力测试和研究展示了此类服务必须处理的问题：有节奏且分散的创建、提供方负责的清理，以及根据声明的运行条件进行校验的评分。 更快的启动应当以到达一个训练步骤的时间及其成本来衡量。

paragraphs.en: Evidence kinds. Production campaigns are our training campaigns A–D (3–17 October) and other jobs on Sandman, analysed after the fact from logs, per-trajectory records, run summaries, the API server’s audit log and cluster metrics. Controlled experiments are dedicated runs on the same shared cluster, next to other tenants’ load, that change one part of the system; A/B arms ran at the same time. Replays feed recorded traces through the real pool code in virtual time, holding the trajectory timeline fixed. Reproductions use a few pods or a local copy of the code; they show that a failure path exists and that a fix closes it, not how often it occurs. Attempts (agent-session starts, retries included), trajectories, pods, gradings, labels and learner steps are counted separately.
paragraphs.zh: 证据种类。 生产活动是我们的训练活动 A–D（10 月 3 日至 17 日）以及 Sandman 上的其他作业，事后从日志、逐轨迹记录、运行摘要、API 服务器的审计日志和集群指标中分析得出。 受控实验是在同一个共享集群上、与其他租户负载并行运行的专门实验，会改变系统的一个部分；A/B 两臂同时运行。 重放将录制的轨迹在虚拟时间中输入真实的资源池代码，并保持轨迹时间线不变。 复现使用少量 Pod 或代码的本地副本；它们只能证明某条故障路径存在且某个修复能将其关闭，而不能说明该故障发生的频率。 尝试次数（智能体会话启动次数，含重试）、轨迹数、Pod 数、评分数、标签数和学习器步数分别计数。

paragraphs.en: Workloads are listed in Table A1 . The RL runs studied here, including campaigns A–D, trained Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with GRPO in groups of 8 samples per task; the A/Bs used campaign C’s recipe on 16 GPUs, and the stress test and the evaluation were other team members’ jobs. Tasks come from SWE-bench Verified Chowdhury et al. (2024) and SWE-Gym Pan et al. (2024) , one image per task. Unless stated otherwise, sandboxes requested 2 vCPU and 8 GiB as requests equal to limits (16 GiB for a few heavy repositories), each test-suite run got a fresh grading pod with an 1,800 s test limit, and the campaigns’ create timeout, which includes the image pull, was 300 s. Trajectories had a 16,384-token budget after the prompt (32,768 in two SWE-Gym runs). Outbound traffic: campaigns A and B ran no outbound guard on any pod (rollout, grading or test re-execution); campaigns C and D and our RL experiments denied outbound traffic on all of these pods; the scale ramp, its follow-up and the placement contrast ran no guard, and the grading-condition study denied outbound traffic only in its egress cells.
paragraphs.zh: 负载列于表 A1。 此处研究的强化学习运行（包括 A–D 批次）使用 GRPO 以每任务 8 个样本为一组训练 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B；A/B 测试在 16 个 GPU 上使用批次 C 的配方，压力测试和评估则是其他团队成员的工作。 任务来自 SWE-bench Verified Chowdhury et al. (2024) 和 SWE-Gym Pan et al. (2024)，每个任务一个镜像。 除非另有说明，沙箱请求 2 vCPU 和 8 GiB 内存且请求等于上限（少数重型仓库为 16 GiB），每次测试套件运行都会获得一个带有 1,800 秒测试时限的新评分 pod，各批次的创建超时（包括镜像拉取）为 300 秒。 轨迹在提示词之后拥有 16,384 个 token 的预算（两次 SWE-Gym 运行为 32,768）。 出站流量：批次 A 和 B 在任何 pod（轨迹生成、评分或测试重新执行）上均未运行出站防护；批次 C 和 D 以及我们的强化学习实验在所有这些 pod 上拒绝出站流量；规模爬坡、其后续实验和放置对比未运行任何防护，而评分条件研究仅在其出站实验组中拒绝出站流量。

paragraphs.en: Cost. At on-demand list prices ($160.645 per hour for an 8-GPU B200 instance, $4.752 per hour for a 96-vCPU, 192 GiB c5d node), the campaigns’ 3.30–3.75 sandbox-hours per B200 GPU-hour cost about 1.7% of the GPU cost if each 2 vCPU, 8 GiB sandbox is charged its node share of CPU (2 of 96 vCPU) and about 3.5% if of memory (8 of 192 GiB); test re-execution and evaluation jobs add 2–7% of that, giving 1.8–3.7%.
paragraphs.zh: 成本。 按按需定价列表价（8-GPU B200 实例每小时 160.645 美元，96 vCPU、192 GiB 的 c5d 节点每小时 4.752 美元）计算，各活动每个 B200 GPU 小时对应 3.30–3.75 个沙箱小时，如果每个 2 vCPU、8 GiB 的沙箱按其占用的 CPU 份额（96 个 vCPU 中的 2 个）计费，其成本约为 GPU 成本的 1.7%；如果按内存份额（192 GiB 中的 8 GiB）计费，则约为 3.5%；测试重执行与评估任务再加 2–7%，总计为 1.8–3.7%。
