paragraphs.en: Seccomp. No pod or container specification of any provider version sets a seccomp profile (a 15 October capture: unset on 6,521 of 6,522 sandbox pods, the one exception not ours), and the CPU nodes’ kubelet configuration is the managed default, which sets no seccomp default, so the kubelet’s default, unconfined, applies. On 27 October two probe pods on one current CPU node read their own status: without a profile, seccomp mode 0 (no filter); with the runtime’s default profile, mode 2 (filtered). Whether that profile changes any verdict is not measured: a pre-registered check stopped before its first grading because the cluster’s admission control began refusing 499 of the 500 Verified task images.

paragraphs.en: Endpoints. A create runs from the provider’s API request until execd answers its health route, so it includes scheduling, address assignment, image pull, container start and the readiness probe. Create-to-Ready runs from the pod’s creation to its Ready condition (API timestamps, 1 s resolution), submit to healthy is what a caller of the provider’s create waits without our pacing queue, and request to first command runs from the acquire call to the first successful command. An acquisition runs from the trainer’s request until it holds a usable sandbox (for a warm pod, a health check and a label change), and the waiting share divides the summed acquisition time of rollout and grading sandboxes (each create or pool wait counted once) by summed trajectory time. A sandbox is live from its completed create until its delete, in use or warm. Availability is the share of attempts, or of trajectories after at most one retry, that got a working sandbox; sandbox-hours per GPU-hour divide summed trajectory time by B200-hours, since the campaigns’ trainer held one sandbox per trajectory at a time. The learner step interval is the mean time between learner steps, and the held-out resolve rate the mean over held-out tasks of passes per valid sample.
paragraphs.zh: 端点。 一次创建从提供商的 API 请求开始，直到 execd 应答其健康路由，因此它包含调度、地址分配、镜像拉取、容器启动和就绪探针。 创建到就绪从 pod 创建开始到其 Ready 条件（API 时间戳，1 秒分辨率）结束；提交到健康是不经我们的节奏排队时提供商的创建调用者所等待的时间；请求到首条命令从 acquire 调用开始到首条成功命令结束。 一次获取从训练器的请求开始，直到它持有一个可用的智能体沙箱（对于温备 pod，即一次健康检查加一次标签更改）；等待占比将 rollout 和评分智能体沙箱的获取时间之和（每次创建或池等待只计一次）除以轨迹时间之和。 一个智能体沙箱从其完成的创建开始直到其删除都算存活，无论是在用还是温备。 可用性是尝试（或最多一次重试后的轨迹）中获得可用智能体沙箱的比例；每 GPU 小时的智能体沙箱小时数将轨迹时间之和除以 B200 小时数，因为这些活动的训练器每条轨迹同一时间只持有一个智能体沙箱。 学习器步进间隔是学习器各步之间的平均时间，留出集解决率是留出集任务上每次有效样本通过率的平均值。

paragraphs.en: This section expands §2 and §5. paragraphs.en: Bursts and early ends. A run starts its 64 trajectories within one second, so two runs starting together created 128 rollout pods in one second (132 creates in all, campaign A’s one-second maximum). In campaign A, 458 of 80,068 ended trajectories ended early, 199 before a pod existed; in the A/Bs, 6,712 of 6,905 errors fell in three incident windows. In campaign D’s first 12 runs, which met the 14 October incidents, 18–83% of starts made no create because fast failures were retried; over the campaign, 1,036,028 starts made 720,332 creates. In D’s other 27 runs, 495,566 of 497,170 starts (99.7%) got a pod. Cluster-wide, the audit log showed 33,236 sandbox pod creates in one hour of 14 October, and one reading found 4,798 live sandbox pods. In campaigns A–C, 33 of the 576,666 attempts in Table A5 (32, 0 and 1) failed because the harness could not reach execd before the agent started.
paragraphs.zh: 突发请求与提前结束。 一次运行在一秒内启动其 64 条轨迹，因此同时开始的两此运行在一秒内创建了 128 个 rollout pod（总共 132 次创建，为活动 A 的一秒最大值）。 在活动 A 中，80,068 条已结束的轨迹里有 458 条提前结束，其中 199 条在 pod 存在之前；在 A/B 测试中，6,905 个错误里有 6,712 个落在三个事件窗口内。 在活动 D 的前 12 次运行中，由于恰逢 10 月 14 日的事件，18–83% 的启动因快速失败被重试而未产生创建；在整个活动期间，1,036,028 次启动产生了 720,332 次创建。 在 D 的其余 27 次运行中，497,170 次启动里有 495,566 次（99.7%）获得了 pod。 在整个集群范围内，审计日志显示 10 月 14 日一小时内共有 33,236 次 sandbox pod 创建，其中一次读数发现 4,798 个存活的 sandbox pod。 在活动 A–C 中，表 A5 的 576,666 次尝试中有 33 次（32、0 和 1）失败，原因是测试框架在智能体启动前无法连接到 execd。

paragraphs.en: A turn’s generation took 1.7–3.0 s at the median, and a live sandbox served 8.8–12.4 tool calls per minute; 85–93% of calls were shell commands, and 28–44% of rollouts ran the tests. With outbound traffic denied, 46–94% of rollouts still tried a package install or download. In a replay against one-minute metrics, pods used 0.001–0.007 vCPU while the model generated and 0.068–0.276 vCPU while busy. The traces hold 136,441 rollouts that ran, of 172,684 attempts in 28 runs.
paragraphs.zh: 一轮的生成耗时中位数为 1.7–3.0 秒，一个实时沙箱每分钟可服务 8.8–12.4 次工具调用；其中 85–93% 的调用是 shell 命令，28–44% 的 rollout 运行了测试。 在出站流量被禁止的情况下，仍有 46–94% 的 rollout 尝试安装或下载软件包。 在基于一分钟指标的回放中，智能体生成时 pod 使用 0.001–0.007 vCPU，忙碌时使用 0.068–0.276 vCPU。 这些轨迹包含 28 次运行中 172,684 次尝试里实际运行了的 136,441 个 rollout。

paragraphs.en: Images. Campaign A requested each of its 24 images a median 3,412 times; the long re-request mode is the next group of the same task, 13–44 minutes later. Rollout pods reached Ready in 5.13–5.97 s at the median on Verified (p99 24.4–60.5 s) and 14.3 s on the SWE-Gym runs (p99 117 s). The 50 images a CPU node lists take a median of 231 GiB, more than its 89 GiB of allocatable ephemeral storage, so images live on the striped NVMe volume; campaign D’s task set fits on one node, the SWE-Gym runs’ 306 images do not.
paragraphs.zh: 镜像。 活动 A 请求其 24 个镜像中每个镜像的中位次数为 3,412 次；下一次重请求模式是同一任务的下一组请求，发生在 13–44 分钟之后。 在 Verified 上，Rollout Pod 达到 Ready 状态的中位时间为 5.13–5.97 秒（p99 为 24.4–60.5 秒），在 SWE-Gym 运行中为 14.3 秒（p99 为 117 秒）。 一个 CPU 节点所列出的 50 个镜像中位数占用 231 GiB，超过了其 89 GiB 的可分配临时存储空间，因此镜像存放在条带化的 NVMe 卷上；活动 D 的任务集可以放入单个节点，而 SWE-Gym 运行的 306 个镜像则不能。

paragraphs.en: Setup. The ramp ran the provider and pool of 14 October, which include the cancelled-create fix, with a benchmark patch for name prefixes and an optional affinity, in 31 steps, 30 of them measured. A driver pod per step fired N N acquires at once (with the pool on, after prewarming N N pods) and timed the first execd call, by pod address or through a per-agent Service. Pods requested 0.1 vCPU and 128 MiB and ran a cached 43 MB image with execd of 7 October, on the 260 m-family nodes, away from the c5d nodes that campaign D’s extension used. A wrapper paced creates, and deletes ran at twice the create rate. A watchdog on admission errors, DNS latency and co-tenant signals never fired. We stopped at 12,000 because free addresses in the pod subnets had fallen from 33.6k to 26.5k, and the tightest subnet is shared with the GPU nodes.
paragraphs.zh: 环境搭建。 该压测在 10 月 14 日的 provider 和 pool 上运行，包含取消创建的修复，外加针对名称前缀的基准补丁和可选的亲和性，共 31 个步骤，其中 30 个被计量。 每个步骤由一个驱动 pod 同时发起 N N 次 acquire（在开启 pool 的情况下，先预热 N N 个 pod），并对首次 execd 调用计时，既按 pod 地址直连，也通过每智能体的 Service。 pod 请求 0.1 vCPU 和 128 MiB，运行一个 43 MB 的缓存镜像（其中 execd 为 10 月 7 日版本），部署在 260 m 系列节点上，避开 D 活动扩展所用的 c5d 节点。 由一个包装器控制创建节奏，删除则以两倍的创建速率运行。 针对 admission 错误、DNS 延迟和共租户信号的看门狗从未触发。 我们在 12,000 处停止，因为 pod 子网中的空闲地址已从 33.6k 降至 26.5k，而最紧张的那个子网与 GPU 节点共享。

paragraphs.en: Where the time went. At the 12,000 step, 11,858 sandboxes were live at the peak (the 11,826 acquired plus 32 late creates kept warm); 83 acquires timed out behind the pacer against the harness’s 600 s budget, 48 of their creates were kept warm and the rest deleted, and no step left a pod. The idle and back-to-back control argues against our own just-released addresses as the cause. Scheduling took about 10 ms and the API create call 27–105 ms at the median; the tail sat between scheduling and the sandbox network being ready. A rate sweep at 99 pods inside the window had more address failures at faster bursts (5.1% at 5/s, 39.4% at 200/s), confounded with time of day.
paragraphs.zh: 时间都去哪儿了。 在第 12,000 步，峰值时有 11,858 个沙箱处于活跃状态（即已获取的 11,826 个加上 32 个保持热备的延迟创建沙箱）；83 次获取在 pacer 之后超时（测试框架的预算为 600 秒），其中 48 次对应的创建被保持热备、其余被删除，且没有任何一步留下残留的 pod。 空闲与背靠背对照实验表明，我们自己刚刚释放的地址并非问题的成因。 调度耗时中位数约为 10 毫秒，API 创建调用为 27–105 毫秒；尾部延迟介于调度完成与沙箱网络就绪之间。 在窗口内 99 个 pod 的速率扫描实验中，突发速率越快，地址失败越多（5/秒时为 5.1%，200/秒时为 39.4%），但该结果与一天中的时间段存在混杂。

paragraphs.en: Services and the pool. The Service’s extra time is route programming, not name lookup (4–9 ms): a warm pod labelled at acquire always needed a retry of its first call, which landed at 2.27 s. Creating 1,000 Services at once drew 237 HTTP 429 answers from the API server’s fairness limits and 4 more on pod creates, and 241 of the 1,000 sandboxes failed; pacing Service creates with the pods’ token bucket gave 1,000 of 1,000, and the driver’s DNS p99 stayed at or below 15 ms up to 1,000 sandboxes. The warm pool did not make pods faster: it moved the pacing queue and the tail into the prewarm (13–218 s from 99 to 2,000 pods), and acquire p50 fell from 8.5–61.9 s to 0.04–0.51 s at 99.2–100% warm hits.
paragraphs.zh: Service 与资源池。 Service 的额外开销在于路由编程，而非名称查找（4–9 毫秒）：在获取时被打上标记的预热 pod 总是需要重试其首次调用，该次调用耗时落在 2.27 秒。 一次性创建 1,000 个 Service 触发了 API 服务器公平性限制的 237 次 HTTP 429 响应，在创建 pod 时又触发 4 次，1,000 个沙箱中有 241 个失败；将 Service 创建与 pod 的令牌桶同步节流后，1,000 个沙箱全部成功，且驱动程序的 DNS p99 在沙箱数量达到 1,000 时仍保持在 15 毫秒或以下。 预热池并未让 pod 变快：它只是把节流队列和长尾移到了预热阶段（从 99 到 2,000 个 pod 为 13–218 秒），而在 99.2–100% 的预热命中率下，获取的 p50 从 8.5–61.9 秒降至 0.04–0.51 秒。

paragraphs.en: Address-assignment follow-up. Two days later we reran the ramp with the same code, image and pod size, with N N interleaved and other tenants’ address failures logged per minute. A co-tenant guard aborted the second 5,000-pod step, and the remaining unspread steps were dropped. The later steps spread the step’s own pods over all 260 nodes (maximum skew 2, or 3 for the realistic step, which ran 2 vCPU, 8 GiB pods on a pre-pulled Verified image). Before that step we pre-pulled its 1.21 GB image onto the 229 of the 260 m-family nodes whose 50-image status list did not show it; 200 already held it and 29 pulled it. Figure 3a also plots the routing and pool arms (Table A12 ), the rate sweep and the controls; its one step of 1,000 outside the window is the paced-Service arm (11:05, 3.0% address failures, p99 46 s).
paragraphs.zh: 地址分配问题的后续跟进。 两天后，我们使用相同的代码、镜像和 Pod 数量重新进行了爬坡测试，N N 交错部署，并按分钟记录其他租户的地址分配失败情况。 一个同租户防护机制中止了第二个 5,000 个 Pod 的步骤，其余未展开的步骤被放弃。 后面的步骤将该步骤自身的 Pod 分散到全部 260 个节点上（最大偏差为 2，现实步骤为 3，该步骤在预拉取的已验证镜像上运行 2 vCPU、8 GiB 的 Pod）。 在该步骤之前，我们将其 1.21 GB 的镜像预拉取到 260 个 m 系列节点中的 229 个上（依据其 50 条镜像状态列表中未显示该镜像）；其中 200 个节点已持有该镜像，29 个节点进行了拉取。 图 3a 还绘制了路由和资源池实验组（表 A12）、速率扫描以及对照组；其在窗口外的一个包含 1,000 个 Pod 的步骤属于限速 Service 实验组（11:05，地址分配失败率 3.0%，p99 为 46 秒）。

paragraphs.en: The tail sat in sandbox and network setup (p99 50–96 s unspread, 2 s spread). Container start to Ready took 4–5 s at 0.1 vCPU but 1 s at 2 vCPU, consistent with execd booting under a small CPU quota. During the aborted step, other tenants’ failures on the shared nodes peaked at 1,422 per minute and fell to 0–28 within a minute of our teardown; in the first ramp they averaged 813 per minute in minutes with at least 300 of our creates and 311 when we were idle. Limits: one day, steps in sequence, one repetition per spread setting, and at most 8 pods per node observed, so above about 2,000 sandboxes the spread needs more nodes or a larger per-node warm-address target.
paragraphs.zh: 尾部延迟出现在沙箱与网络设置阶段（未扩散时 p99 为 50–96 秒，扩散后为 2 秒）。 容器从启动到 Ready 在 0.1 vCPU 下耗时 4–5 秒，而在 2 vCPU 下仅 1 秒，这与智能体（execd）在较小 CPU 配额下启动的情况一致。 在中止步骤期间，共享节点上其他租户的失败次数峰值达到每分钟 1,422 次，并在我们拆除后一分钟内降至每分钟 0–28 次；在第一轮爬升阶段，在我们每分钟至少有 300 次 创建操作 的分钟里，失败次数平均为每分钟 813 次，而在我们空闲时为 311 次。 局限性：实验仅一天、各步骤顺序执行、每种扩散设置只重复一次，且每个节点最多观察到 8 个 Pod，因此当沙箱数量超过约 2,000 个时，扩散需要更多节点或更大的每节点预热地址目标。

paragraphs.en: Back-to-back placement contrast (27 October). A pre-registered experiment then compared placement at a fixed create rate: same driver, code, 43 MB image (by digest), 0.1 vCPU and 128 MiB pods, and the 375 schedulable CPU-pool nodes. A batch of 1,000 pods with a soft topology spread (maximum skew 2 per node) ran 08:38:58–08:42:48, then, after a 180 s idle gap, a batch of 1,000 with the default scheduler ran 08:45:48–08:50:02, both paced at 10 creates per second by our pacer. Spreading used all 375 nodes with at most 3 of the batch’s pods each; the default scheduler used 72 nodes, up to 65 each (p50 11). No spread pod logged an address-assignment failure; 254 of the 1,000 default pods did (419 events), and all of them later became Ready, with create-to-Ready p50 22 s and p99 64 s against 6 and 8 s for the rest. Over all 1,000 pods, create-to-Ready p99 was 8 s spread and 57 s default. The spread batch pulled the image on 263 nodes that lacked it; the default batch found it on every node, which favours the default batch. The caller’s wait from submission, p50 / p90 / p99, was 56.2 / 96.5 / 105.8 s spread and 61.8 / 100.3 / 121.0 s default, most of it (p50 50 s in both) in our pacer’s queue before the create call. A pre-registered rule on other tenants’ failures per minute stopped the experiment after these two of twelve planned cells: per scheduled pod, other tenants’ failures were 0.23–0.37% when we were idle, 0.66% during the spread batch, 1.56% during the default batch and 1.65% after we stopped. With one pair, no rate contrast and no repetition, this is one observation; pacing itself was not varied.
paragraphs.zh: 背靠背放置对比（10 月 27 日）。 一项预先注册的实验随后在固定创建速率下对比了放置效果：相同的驱动程序、代码、43 MB 镜像（按摘要）、0.1 vCPU 和 128 MiB 的 Pod，以及 375 个可调度的 CPU 池节点。 一批具有软拓扑打散约束（每节点最大偏差为 2）的 1,000 个 Pod 在 08:38:58–08:42:48 运行，随后经过 180 秒的空闲间隔，一批使用默认调度器的 1,000 个 Pod 在 08:45:48–08:50:02 运行，两者均由我们的节流器以每秒 10 次创建的速率进行控制。 拓扑打散批次使用了全部 375 个节点，每个节点最多承载该批次 3 个 Pod；默认调度器使用了 72 个节点，每个节点最多 65 个（p50 为 11）。 拓扑打散批次没有 Pod 记录到地址分配失败；默认批次的 1,000 个 Pod 中有 254 个出现了失败（419 个事件），且这些 Pod 随后全部变为 Ready 状态，从创建到 Ready 的 p50 为 22 秒、p99 为 64 秒，而其余 Pod 分别为 6 秒和 8 秒。 在全部 1,000 个 Pod 中，从创建到 Ready 的 p99 在拓扑打散批次为 8 秒，默认批次为 57 秒。 拓扑打散批次在原本缺少该镜像的 263 个节点上拉取了镜像；默认批次则在每个节点上都找到了该镜像，这一点对默认批次有利。 调用方从提交到返回的等待时间（p50 / p90 / p99）在拓扑打散批次为 56.2 / 96.5 / 105.8 秒，默认批次为 61.8 / 100.3 / 121.0 秒，其中大部分时间（两者 p50 均为 50 秒）是在创建调用之前排队等待我们的节流器。 一条关于其他租户每分钟故障数的预先注册规则在这十二个计划单元中的这两个之后终止了实验：按每个被调度的 Pod 计算，当我们空闲时其他租户的故障率为 0.23–0.37%，拓扑打散批次期间为 0.66%，默认批次期间为 1.56%，我们停止之后为 1.65%。 由于只有一对组合、没有速率对比、也没有重复实验，这只是一次观察；节流速率本身未被改变。

sents.en: Back-to-back placement contrast (27 October).

sents.en: A pre-registered experiment then compared placement at a fixed create rate: same driver, code, 43 MB image (by digest), 0.1 vCPU and 128 MiB pods, and the 375 schedulable CPU-pool nodes.
sents.zh: 一项预先注册的实验随后在固定创建速率下对比了放置效果：相同的驱动程序、代码、43 MB 镜像（按摘要）、0.1 vCPU 和 128 MiB 的 Pod，以及 375 个可调度的 CPU 池节点。

sents.en: A batch of 1,000 pods with a soft topology spread (maximum skew 2 per node) ran 08:38:58–08:42:48, then, after a 180 s idle gap, a batch of 1,000 with the default scheduler ran 08:45:48–08:50:02, both paced at 10 creates per second by our pacer.
sents.zh: 一批具有软拓扑打散约束（每节点最大偏差为 2）的 1,000 个 Pod 在 08:38:58–08:42:48 运行，随后经过 180 秒的空闲间隔，一批使用默认调度器的 1,000 个 Pod 在 08:45:48–08:50:02 运行，两者均由我们的节流器以每秒 10 次创建的速率进行控制。

sents.en: Spreading used all 375 nodes with at most 3 of the batch’s pods each; the default scheduler used 72 nodes, up to 65 each (p50 11).
sents.zh: 拓扑打散批次使用了全部 375 个节点，每个节点最多承载该批次 3 个 Pod；默认调度器使用了 72 个节点，每个节点最多 65 个（p50 为 11）。

sents.en: No spread pod logged an address-assignment failure; 254 of the 1,000 default pods did (419 events), and all of them later became Ready, with create-to-Ready p50 22 s and p99 64 s against 6 and 8 s for the rest.
sents.zh: 拓扑打散批次没有 Pod 记录到地址分配失败；默认批次的 1,000 个 Pod 中有 254 个出现了失败（419 个事件），且这些 Pod 随后全部变为 Ready 状态，从创建到 Ready 的 p50 为 22 秒、p99 为 64 秒，而其余 Pod 分别为 6 秒和 8 秒。

sents.en: The spread batch pulled the image on 263 nodes that lacked it; the default batch found it on every node, which favours the default batch.
sents.zh: 拓扑打散批次在原本缺少该镜像的 263 个节点上拉取了镜像；默认批次则在每个节点上都找到了该镜像，这一点对默认批次有利。

sents.en: The caller’s wait from submission, p50 / p90 / p99, was 56.2 / 96.5 / 105.8 s spread and 61.8 / 100.3 / 121.0 s default, most of it (p50 50 s in both) in our pacer’s queue before the create call.

sents.en: A pre-registered rule on other tenants’ failures per minute stopped the experiment after these two of twelve planned cells: per scheduled pod, other tenants’ failures were 0.23–0.37% when we were idle, 0.66% during the spread batch, 1.56% during the default batch and 1.65% after we stopped.
sents.zh: 一条关于其他租户每分钟故障数的预先注册规则在这十二个计划单元中的这两个之后终止了实验：按每个被调度的 Pod 计算，当我们空闲时其他租户的故障率为 0.23–0.37%，拓扑打散批次期间为 0.66%，默认批次期间为 1.56%，我们停止之后为 1.65%。

sents.en: With one pair, no rate contrast and no repetition, this is one observation; pacing itself was not varied.
sents.zh: 由于只有一对组合、没有速率对比、也没有重复实验，这只是一次观察；节流速率本身未被改变。

paragraphs.en: This analysis used only records that earlier controlled runs had saved: re-grading sandboxes of a SWE-Gym label re-grade (20 October; its two reference cells used 59 images of a 230-task set on 184 nodes), the same study’s GRPO run, the ramp’s small-image steps, the follow-up’s step with a Verified image present, and the warm-pool A/B. Each table row uses one source. No source controlled the node’s image cache, so each pod’s cache state comes from kubelet events.
paragraphs.zh: 本分析仅使用了早期受控运行所保存的记录：SWE-Gym 标签重评级（10 月 20 日）的重评级沙箱（其两个参考单元在 184 个节点上使用了 230 个任务集的 59 个镜像）、同一研究的 GRPO 运行、爬坡阶段的小镜像步骤、后续研究中存在 Verified 镜像的步骤，以及预热池 A/B 测试。 每个表格行仅使用一个来源。 没有任何来源控制节点的镜像缓存，因此每个 Pod 的缓存状态来自 kubelet 事件。

sents.zh: 每个表格行仅使用一个来源。

sents.en: No source controlled the node’s image cache, so each pod’s cache state comes from kubelet events.
sents.zh: 没有任何来源控制节点的镜像缓存，因此每个 Pod 的缓存状态来自 kubelet 事件。

paragraphs.en: Units and endpoints were fixed before the numbers were read. A pod is on demand, image pulled when its first task-image container has “pulling” and “pulled” events, image present when the event says the image was already present, and prewarmed when it is a pool hit on a pod nobody had used. “Pulled” means the node lacked that image reference, though shared layers may have been present, and image size is the whole compressed image, not the bytes transferred. The small-image steps give request to first command; the re-grading sandboxes give the provider’s create time, without the first command.
paragraphs.zh: 在读取数据之前，单位和终点已事先固定。 Pod 按需计（on demand），当其首个 task-image 容器出现“pulling”和“pulled”事件时计为镜像已拉取（image pulled），事件表明镜像本已存在时计为镜像已存在（image present），而命中一个无人使用过的 Pod 池时计为已预热（prewarmed）。“Pulled”表示该节点缺少该镜像引用，但共享的层可能已经存在；镜像大小指整个压缩镜像，而非实际传输的字节数。 小镜像步骤给出从请求到第一条命令的时间；重新评分沙箱给出服务商的创建时间，不含第一条命令。

sents.zh: 在读取数据之前，单位和终点已事先固定。

paragraphs.en: No pull waited in the kubelet’s queue (1,204 pulls), and the training run’s pods agree (782 pulled pods, pull p50 13.9 s). The pooled pull median (13.5 s) is below the median of per-image medians (33.4 s) because the most re-pulled images are small, so the image mix sets the pooled number. Pull rates reached 442 MB/s, which suggests shared layers, and 0.58% of pulls exceeded the provider’s default 120 s readiness budget.
paragraphs.zh: kubelet 队列中没有等待的拉取（1,204 次拉取），训练任务的 pod 也印证了这一点（拉取了 782 个 pod，拉取 p50 为 13.9 秒）。 合并的拉取中位数（13.5 秒）低于各镜像中位数的中位数（33.4 秒），因为被重复拉取最多的镜像都很小，所以镜像组合决定了合并后的数值。 拉取速率达到 442 MB/s，这表明存在共享层，且有 0.58% 的拉取超过了提供商默认的 120 秒就绪预算。

sents.en: No pull waited in the kubelet’s queue (1,204 pulls), and the training run’s pods agree (782 pulled pods, pull p50 13.9 s).
sents.zh: kubelet 队列中没有等待的拉取（1,204 次拉取），训练任务的 pod 也印证了这一点（拉取了 782 个 pod，拉取 p50 为 13.9 秒）。

sents.en: The pooled pull median (13.5 s) is below the median of per-image medians (33.4 s) because the most re-pulled images are small, so the image mix sets the pooled number.
sents.zh: 合并的拉取中位数（13.5 秒）低于各镜像中位数的中位数（33.4 秒），因为被重复拉取最多的镜像都很小，所以镜像组合决定了合并后的数值。

sents.en: Pull rates reached 442 MB/s, which suggests shared layers, and 0.58% of pulls exceeded the provider’s default 120 s readiness budget.
sents.zh: 拉取速率达到 442 MB/s，这表明存在共享层，且有 0.58% 的拉取超过了提供商默认的 120 秒就绪预算。

paragraphs.en: Small images and warm pods. With the 43 MB image, request to first command took 9.11 s at the median when the node pulled the image, 8.30 s when it had it, and 51 ms for a never-used warm pod (33, 66 and 99 pods). The pull itself took 0.17 s, and within a step the two on-demand units had the same submit-to-healthy time (5.15 against 5.11 s), so their difference in request time is our pacer’s queue. With the 1.21 GB Verified image present, 998 pods at 2 vCPU went from submit to healthy in 2.08 s at the median. Prewarming does the same create earlier and pays in idle reservation: warm pods of the warm-pool A/B idled 121–256 s at the median before first use. Limits: 359 re-grading pods had no grading record and longer pulls, so the cold tail is slightly optimistic, and the records cannot separate download from unpack, give bytes transferred, or time the first command on a SWE image.
paragraphs.zh: 小镜像与暖 Pod。 使用 43 MB 镜像时，当节点拉取镜像，从请求到首个命令的中位耗时为 9.11 秒；节点已有镜像时为 8.30 秒；而从未使用过的暖 Pod 仅为 51 毫秒（分别为 33、66 和 99 个 Pod）。 拉取本身耗时 0.17 秒，且在同一步骤内，两个按需单元的提交到健康时间相同（5.15 秒对 5.11 秒），因此它们在请求时间上的差异就是我们的节奏器队列延迟。 在已有 1.21 GB 已验证镜像的情况下，998 个 2 vCPU 的 Pod 从提交到健康的中位耗时为 2.08 秒。 预热只是把同样的创建动作提前执行，并以空闲预留为代价：暖池 A/B 实验中的暖 Pod 在首次使用前的中位空闲时间为 121–256 秒。 局限：359 个重新评分的 Pod 没有评分记录且拉取时间更长，因此冷启动尾部数据略偏乐观；此外这些记录无法区分下载与解压，无法给出传输字节数，也无法测量 SWE 镜像上首个命令的耗时。

sents.zh: 小镜像与暖 Pod。

sents.en: Limits: 359 re-grading pods had no grading record and longer pulls, so the cold tail is slightly optimistic, and the records cannot separate download from unpack, give bytes transferred, or time the first command on a SWE image.
sents.zh: 局限：359 个重新评分的 Pod 没有评分记录且拉取时间更长，因此冷启动尾部数据略偏乐观；此外这些记录无法区分下载与解压，无法给出传输字节数，也无法测量 SWE 镜像上首个命令的耗时。

paragraphs.en: Designs. Both A/Bs ran concurrent pairs of 16-GPU GRPO runs with campaign C’s recipe and 128 trajectories in flight; the arms of a pair differed only in how grading sandboxes were obtained. Rollout pods were created on demand in both arms, because the trainer of that time used the pool for rollouts only with a verified Service binding, which needed permissions the sandbox account lacked. Pair 1 ran on 18 October and pairs 2 and 3 on 22 October from the same manifests, when the cluster API was slower (rollout create p50 6.1 and 7.5 s against 5.3 s). The warm-pool A/B ran 25 learner steps on 88 tasks: one fresh pod per grading against 2 warm pods per (image, base commit) with a 2,100 s idle timeout. The checked-reuse A/B ran 40 steps on 86 tasks that had passed the reference/empty-patch check: a single-use warm pool with a global budget of 96 pods, at least 2 per key and a 300 s timeout, against the same pool with checked reuse of grading pods, at most 8 reuses per pod.
paragraphs.zh: 设计。 两个 A/B 实验都同时运行成对的 16-GPU GRPO 训练任务，采用活动 C 的配方并有 128 条轨迹在途；一对中的两个分支仅在评分沙箱的获取方式上有所不同。 两个分支中 rollout Pod 都是按需创建的，因为当时的训练器仅在存在经过验证的 Service 绑定时才使用资源池进行 rollout，而该绑定所需的权限沙箱账户并不具备。 第 1 对于 10 月 18 日运行，第 2 和第 3 对于 10 月 22 日使用相同的清单运行，当时集群 API 较慢（rollout 创建 p50 分别为 6.1 秒和 7.5 秒，对比 5.3 秒）。 预热资源池 A/B 在 88 个任务上运行了 25 个学习器步骤：每次评分使用一个全新 Pod，对比每个（镜像，基础提交）保留 2 个预热 Pod 并设置 2,100 秒的空闲超时。 校验复用 A/B 在 86 个通过参考/空补丁检查的任务上运行了 40 个步骤：一次性预热资源池，全局预算为 96 个 Pod，每个键至少 2 个，超时 300 秒，对比相同的资源池但允许对评分 Pod 进行校验复用，每个 Pod 最多复用 8 次。

paragraphs.en: The pool-on run reached step 24 sooner in all three pairs (ratio 0.906, 95% CI 0.870–0.941, so 9.4% less wall clock); the time was gained in different phases in different pairs, and the effect on the step interval over steps 2–24, and whether faster acquisition caused the gain, remained inconclusive.

paragraphs.en: Pool sizing replay. Each pool-on trace was replayed through the real pool code in virtual time, three seeds per trace (Table A19 ). In pair 1 about 35 images were graded in any 5 minutes, and the run cycled through its 88 images about every 27 minutes, inside the 2,100 s idle timeout. A second replay compared three ways to get a grading pod on eight recorded traces, through the pool code the frozen deployment ran: fresh on demand; a tuned single-use warm pool, the setting with the fewest idle pod-hours that reached 95% hits on a registered grid; and checked reuse at that pool’s settings (Table A20 ).

paragraphs.en: Checked reuse cut creates per grading by 26–46% on the five Verified and natural-pool traces and by 39–41% on two SWE-Gym runs, but by 6% on the third, where a budget of 32 pods binds; it raised pod-hours on every trace, by 2–60%. On the SWE-Gym traces no single-use setting reached 95% hits. The replay matches the runs it can be checked against (control 1.306 creates per grading against 1.306 measured; treatment 0.920 against 0.934). Every trace replays one pod spec without pacing, and the results hold for our pool policy, which starts a replacement create on every acquire.
paragraphs.zh: 在五个 Verified 与自然池轨迹上，经检查的复用削减使每次评分的创建次数降低 26–46%；在两次 SWE-Gym 运行上降低 39–41%；但在第三次运行上仅降低 6%，那里 32 个 pod 的预算构成约束；它在每条轨迹上都增加了 pod 小时，增幅为 2–60%。 在 SWE-Gym 轨迹上，没有任何单次使用的设置达到 95% 的命中率。 该重放与可对其检验的运行相吻合（对照组每次评分 1.306 次创建，实测为 1.306；实验组为 0.920，实测为 0.934）。 每条轨迹在无节流的情况下重放单一的 pod 规格，且结果对我们的池策略成立，该策略在每次获取时启动一个替代性创建。

paragraphs.en: The stress-test leak (§4.4; first row of the paper’s Table 2) exercised one window. To cover the others we drove the unmodified provider and pool code of the version before the cancellation fix (13 October), the version with it (21 October) and, in a second run, the version with the error-path fix as well (27 October) against a stand-in Kubernetes API on one development host.

paragraphs.en: Real code, stand-in API. Each version’s provider and pool ran unmodified from its exported source tree, building real Kubernetes model objects and calling the synchronous client from worker threads, as in production. Only the API object was replaced, by a stand-in with create, read, delete and patch running in the same threads; a local handler answered health probes once a pod was Ready, and the event loop’s executor could hold a work item and log whether a cancellation could still stop it.
paragraphs.zh: 真实代码，替身 API。 每个版本的 provider 和 pool 都直接从其导出的源码树中未经修改地运行，构建真实的 Kubernetes 模型对象，并从工作线程调用同步客户端，与生产环境一致。 只有 API 对象被替换为一个替身，其创建、读取、删除和补丁操作在同一线程中运行；本地处理器在 Pod 进入 Ready 状态后响应健康探测，并且事件循环的执行器可以持有一个工作项并记录取消操作是否仍能将其停止。

paragraphs.en: Gates, triggers and audit. A gate holds the first matching call (a work item not yet started, a create received or stored but not answered, a Ready poll, the health probe, or a delete) until the test releases it. Triggers are never timers: the test waits until the gate is reached, then cancels the caller, lets the pool’s 50 ms acquire timeout expire, or calls the drain, and releases the hold 50 ms later. Failure plans inject a 403, a 504 or a reset connection after the pod was stored, a failed or lost delete, and pods that fail or never become Ready. An independent auditor then lists the stand-in’s pod store and attributes each pod to whoever can still delete it (the caller’s handle, an exception carrying its identity, or the pool’s books); a pod with none is without an owner . In the first run each of windows 1–24 ran 20 times on Python 3.11 and 3.12, for the versions before and with the cancellation fix and an alternative implementation: 2,880 trials. 2,680 hit their window; the other 200 are the old version’s two-stage windows, whose second stage never occurs. Each group’s outcome and pod event order were identical in 20 of 20 repeats.
paragraphs.zh: 闸门、触发器与审计。 闸门会扣住第一个匹配的调用（尚未开始的工作项、已收到或已存储但未应答的 create、Ready 轮询、健康探测，或 delete），直到测试放行为止。 触发器绝不使用定时器：测试会等到闸门处被触及，然后取消调用方、让池的 50 ms 获取超时到期，或调用 drain，并在 50 ms 后解除扣留。 失败计划会在 pod 被存储之后注入 403、504 或连接重置，注入失败或丢失的 delete，以及注入失败或永远无法变为 Ready 的 pod。 随后由一个独立的审计器列出替身（stand-in）的 pod 存储，并把每个 pod 归属给仍然能够删除它的一方（调用方的句柄、携带其身份的异常，或池的账目）；没有任何一方的 pod 即为无主。 在第一轮运行中，窗口 1–24 各自在 Python 3.11 和 3.12 上运行 20 次，覆盖修复取消问题之前的版本、包含该修复的版本以及一种替代实现：共 2,880 次试验。其中 2,680 次命中了各自窗口；另外 200 次是旧版本的两段式窗口，其第二段从未发生。 每个组的结果和 pod 事件顺序在 20 次重复中的 20 次里完全一致。

paragraphs.en: Timing and cost. With the old version the caller saw its error within a millisecond at the median, and the pod was never deleted. The cancellation fix pays for ownership with waiting: a cancelled caller returns after the create in flight and the delete; a cancel before the request is sent still sends it, so under overload each timed-out acquire still creates; and an abandoned rollout create is deleted only at Ready or when the readiness budget runs out. In the old version the pool’s books held no pod while the store held one after window 12, so a capacity cap kept in the pool could not stop the leak.
paragraphs.zh: 时序与成本。 在旧版本中，调用方中位数在一毫秒内就能看到自己的错误，并且 pod 从未被删除。 取消修复用等待换取了所有权：被取消的调用方会等到进行中的 create 和 delete 完成后才返回；在请求发出前取消仍会把请求发出，因此在过载情况下，每次超时的 acquire 仍会创建一个智能体；而被放弃的 rollout create 只会在 Ready 时或就绪预算耗尽时才被删除。 在旧版本中，窗口 12 之后池的账面上没有 pod 而存储中却持有一个，因此保留在池中的容量上限无法阻止泄漏。

paragraphs.en: The alternative implementation deletes after any create error, closing windows 16 and 18, and returns a failed cleanup to the caller with the pod’s identity, which a retrying caller used to remove the pod in 20 of 20 trials. Its pool still forgot a pod whose release failed (window 24), its error lost the identity across a process boundary such as our separate pool process, and it deleted late grading pods instead of reusing them.
paragraphs.zh: 该替代实现会在任何创建错误后进行删除，关闭窗口 16 和 18，并向调用方返回一个携带该 pod 身份的清理失败结果，重试的调用方利用该身份在 20 次试验中的 20 次里成功删除了该 pod。 它的池仍然会遗忘一个释放失败的 pod（窗口 24），其错误会在跨进程边界（例如我们独立的池进程）时丢失身份信息，并且它会删除延迟评分的 pod 而不是复用它们。

sents.en: The alternative implementation deletes after any create error, closing windows 16 and 18, and returns a failed cleanup to the caller with the pod’s identity, which a retrying caller used to remove the pod in 20 of 20 trials.
sents.zh: 该替代实现会在任何创建错误后进行删除，关闭窗口 16 和 18，并向调用方返回一个携带该 pod 身份的清理失败结果，重试的调用方利用该身份在 20 次试验中的 20 次里成功删除了该 pod。

sents.zh: 它的池仍然会遗忘一个释放失败的 pod（窗口 24），其错误会在跨进程边界（例如我们独立的池进程）时丢失身份信息，并且它会删除延迟评分的 pod 而不是复用它们。

paragraphs.en: The error-path fix (27 October). Each create now carries a nonce. After a 5xx or a transport error the provider reads the pod by its pre-assigned name and deletes it, with a UID precondition, only if it carries that nonce; a 4xx or a 409 sends no read and no delete. A delete that fails, loses its answer or is cancelled enters an owned pending set, retried with backoff from 1 s to 30 s and flushed by the drain, and the pool keeps a handle whose release failed. We reran all windows plus window 25 (a create answered 409 because another tenant’s pod holds the name) on four versions and two Python versions, 20 repeats each (4,000 trials), each trial with a sentinel pod of another tenant. The fix left no pod without an owner in any window: windows 16 and 18 are read back and deleted, and failed or lost deletes (19, 21–24) are deleted by the retry about 1.0 s later. It never deleted the sentinel (0 of 1,000 trials), while the alternative implementation deleted the pod holding the name in all 40 of its window-25 trials. All other windows behave as with the cancellation fix alone, including parking late grading pods (Table A21 ). Pending deletes are lost if the provider’s event loop closes first, as in the trainer’s actor teardown; the owner reference is then the backstop.
paragraphs.zh: 错误路径修复（10月27日）。 现在每次创建都携带一个随机数（nonce）。 在出现 5xx 或传输错误后，提供者会按预先分配的名称读取 Pod 并删除它，且带有 UID 前置条件，仅当其携带该随机数时才删除；4xx 或 409 则不会进行读取和删除。 删除失败、丢失响应或被取消的操作会进入一个由其拥有的待处理集合，以从 1 秒到 30 秒的退避策略重试，并在排空（drain）时清空，同时资源池会保留一个释放失败的处理句柄。 我们在四个版本和两个 Python 版本上重跑了所有窗口以及窗口 25（因另一租户的 Pod 占用该名称导致创建返回 409），每个组合重复 20 次（共 4,000 次试验），每次试验都带有一个属于另一租户的哨兵 Pod。 该修复使得任何窗口中都不再出现无主的 Pod：窗口 16 和 18 的 Pod 被读取并删除，而失败或丢失的删除（19、21–24）会由重试在约 1.0 秒后完成删除。 它从未删除过哨兵 Pod（1,000 次试验中 0 次），而另一种实现在其窗口 25 的全部 40 次试验中都删除了占用该名称的 Pod。 所有其他窗口的表现与仅有取消修复时一致，包括搁置迟到的评分 Pod（表 A21）。 如果提供者的事件循环先行关闭（例如在训练器的 actor 清理阶段），待处理的删除就会丢失；此时所有者引用便成为兜底机制。

sents.zh: 错误路径修复（10月27日）。

sents.zh: 现在每次创建都携带一个随机数（nonce）。

sents.en: After a 5xx or a transport error the provider reads the pod by its pre-assigned name and deletes it, with a UID precondition, only if it carries that nonce; a 4xx or a 409 sends no read and no delete.
sents.zh: 在出现 5xx 或传输错误后，提供者会按预先分配的名称读取 Pod 并删除它，且带有 UID 前置条件，仅当其携带该随机数时才删除；4xx 或 409 则不会进行读取和删除。

sents.en: A delete that fails, loses its answer or is cancelled enters an owned pending set, retried with backoff from 1 s to 30 s and flushed by the drain, and the pool keeps a handle whose release failed.
sents.zh: 删除失败、丢失响应或被取消的操作会进入一个由其拥有的待处理集合，以从 1 秒到 30 秒的退避策略重试，并在排空（drain）时清空，同时资源池会保留一个释放失败的处理句柄。

sents.en: We reran all windows plus window 25 (a create answered 409 because another tenant’s pod holds the name) on four versions and two Python versions, 20 repeats each (4,000 trials), each trial with a sentinel pod of another tenant.
sents.zh: 我们在四个版本和两个 Python 版本上重跑了所有窗口以及窗口 25（因另一租户的 Pod 占用该名称导致创建返回 409），每个组合重复 20 次（共 4,000 次试验），每次试验都带有一个属于另一租户的哨兵 Pod。

sents.en: The fix left no pod without an owner in any window: windows 16 and 18 are read back and deleted, and failed or lost deletes (19, 21–24) are deleted by the retry about 1.0 s later.
sents.zh: 该修复使得任何窗口中都不再出现无主的 Pod：窗口 16 和 18 的 Pod 被读取并删除，而失败或丢失的删除（19、21–24）会由重试在约 1.0 秒后完成删除。

sents.en: It never deleted the sentinel (0 of 1,000 trials), while the alternative implementation deleted the pod holding the name in all 40 of its window-25 trials.
sents.zh: 它从未删除过哨兵 Pod（1,000 次试验中 0 次），而另一种实现在其窗口 25 的全部 40 次试验中都删除了占用该名称的 Pod。

sents.en: All other windows behave as with the cancellation fix alone, including parking late grading pods (Table A21 ).
sents.zh: 所有其他窗口的表现与仅有取消修复时一致，包括搁置迟到的评分 Pod（表 A21）。

sents.en: Pending deletes are lost if the provider’s event loop closes first, as in the trainer’s actor teardown; the owner reference is then the backstop.
sents.zh: 如果提供者的事件循环先行关闭（例如在训练器的 actor 清理阶段），待处理的删除就会丢失；此时所有者引用便成为兜底机制。

paragraphs.en: Live checks. On the shared cluster we repeated, with tiny real pods and unmodified code, the three cancellation windows a real API server produces reliably: an acquire timeout before the pod is Ready, a cancel during the readiness wait, and a drain during a warm build. All 17 trials hit their window. The 16 cancellation trials, 16 of the paper’s 25 cluster trials, left no pod: late grading pods were parked and reused by the next acquire (4 of 4), late rollout pods deleted once Ready (4 of 4), and cancels and drains sent the delete within 0.05 s (8 of 8); in the 17th, an owner-reference check outside the 25, a late pod kept on purpose, still owned, was removed by the garbage collector about 11 s after its owner’s delete request. With the error-path fix, nine trials left no pod: six in which the client changed one answer (a 504 or a reset after a stored create, a failed or lost delete, a failed release, a 409) and three repeats of the cancellation windows; the pod holding the conflicting name survived. These faults were injected at the client; how often the real API server produces them is not measured.
paragraphs.zh: 实时检查。 在共享集群上，我们用微型的真实 pod 和未经修改的代码，重复了真实 API 服务器能可靠产生的三个取消窗口：pod 就绪（Ready）之前的获取超时、就绪等待期间的取消，以及预热构建期间的排空。 全部 17 次试验都命中了各自的窗口。 在 16 次取消试验（即论文 25 次集群试验中的 16 次）中都没有留下 pod：迟到的评分 pod 被停驻并由下一次获取复用（4 次中的 4 次），迟到的发布 pod 在就绪后被删除（4 次中的 4 次），取消和排空在 0.05 秒内发出了删除请求（8 次中的 8 次）；在第 17 次试验中（一项不在 25 次之列的所有者引用检查），一个特意保留的、仍被持有的迟到 pod，在其所有者的删除请求之后约 11 秒被垃圾回收器清除。 通过错误路径修复，九次试验没有留下 pod：六次是客户端更改了一个答案（存储创建之后的 504 或连接重置、删除失败或丢失、释放失败、409），三次是取消窗口的重复；持有冲突名称的 pod 得以存活。 这些故障是在客户端注入的；真实 API 服务器产生它们的频率并未测量。

paragraphs.en: Not modelled: admission webhooks, fairness limits, quotas, conflicts, finalizers and graceful deletion (a real pod stays terminating for 5 s); watches, scheduling, pulls, address assignment and probe timing; the real client’s retries and timeouts (a retried delete could turn window 20 into a clean “not found”); scale and contention (production timeouts of 120–600 s scaled to 50 ms); how often these windows occur; and the trainer’s own fallbacks.
paragraphs.zh: 未建模：准入 Webhook、公平性限制、配额、冲突、终结器（finalizers）与优雅删除（真实的 Pod 会保持 terminating 状态 5 秒）；watch、调度、拉取、地址分配与探测时机；真实客户端的重试与超时（一次重试的删除可能把窗口 20 变成一个干净的“未找到”）；规模与竞争（生产环境的 120–600 秒超时被缩放为 50 毫秒）；这些窗口出现的频率；以及训练器自身的回退机制。

paragraphs.en: Method. These reproductions ran on 27 October on one development host (8 vCPU, 30 GiB, Docker) with no cluster access. execd ran as a SWE sandbox pod runs it: in a SWE-bench task image (django-11099), started with the image’s own interpreter as process 1, with its source mounted read-only from the stated version, one fresh container per case, reached over loopback HTTP; agent-level cases ran the agent’s real tools. Every table records how we know its condition happened. A second full run, except the unterminated-input case, gave identical tables apart from timing.
paragraphs.zh: 方法。 这些复现于 10 月 27 日在单台开发主机（8 vCPU、30 GiB、Docker）上运行，无集群访问。execd 以 SWE 沙箱 pod 运行它的方式运行：在 SWE-bench 任务镜像（django-11099）中，以镜像自带的解释器作为 1 号进程启动，其源代码从指定版本以只读方式挂载，每个用例一个全新容器，通过环回 HTTP 访问；智能体层级的用例运行智能体的真实工具。 每张表都记录了我们如何得知其条件已发生。 第二次完整运行（未终止输入用例除外）给出的各表除计时外完全相同。

sents.zh: 方法。

paragraphs.en: When the shell died while a child held the output pipe, execd noticed only at the 300 s timeout, on both versions. A child in its own session survives a reset, but the state check finds it and its restore kills it. The agent’s shell tool drops execd ’s error text, so for a shell death the model sees only exit code 1.
paragraphs.zh: 当 shell 在子进程仍持有输出管道时死亡，两个版本中 execd 都只在 300 秒超时后才察觉。 拥有独立会话的子进程能在重置后存活，但状态检查会发现它，其恢复操作会将其杀死。 智能体的 shell 工具会丢弃 execd 的错误文本，因此当 shell 死亡时，模型只能看到退出码 1。

sents.zh: 当 shell 在子进程仍持有输出管道时死亡，两个版本中 execd 都只在 300 秒超时后才察觉。

paragraphs.en: Truncated display reads. The corpus was every tracked file of two task repositories and the Python files of two package trees: 16,429 text files, 408 of them longer than the 2,000-line window. The agent’s edit tool changed one line in each, once past line 2,000 and once inside the window, while a loopback proxy recorded the editor’s reads and writes. With the old stack the edits inside the window lost 655,315 lines in all; either fix removes the truncation, and the length and SHA-256 check also makes a version mismatch fail closed (Table A23 ).
paragraphs.zh: 截断显示的读取内容。 语料库包含两个任务仓库的所有被追踪文件以及两个软件包目录树中的 Python 文件：共 16,429 个文本文件，其中 408 个超出了 2,000 行的窗口范围。 智能体的编辑工具在每一处各修改了一行——一次在第 2,000 行之后，一次在窗口之内，同时由回环代理记录编辑器的读取与写入操作。 使用旧技术栈时，窗口内的编辑总共丢失了 655,315 行；两种修复方案均可消除截断问题，而且长度和 SHA-256 校验也能使版本不匹配的情况默认失败（表 A23）。

paragraphs.en: Line endings. Of the corpus’s 386 CRLF-only files, 376 belong to one installed copy of pip; Table A24 covers the 385 that have a unique line to edit. The old read dropped the final newline in 873 of the 892 sampled files and flattened CRLF in all 385 CRLF files and the mixed-ending probe. The 19 August whole-file read refuses files that are not valid UTF-8; the exact-bytes path delivers their original bytes, but the editor before 27 October decoded them as UTF-8 and wrote replacement characters, and normalized line endings to the first one it saw. The editor of 27 October refuses, before any write, a file that is not valid UTF-8, mixes CRLF and LF, or contains a bare CR, and tells the agent to use the shell; every other file edits as before. These tests cover exact-match edits only: an edit whose target text matches only after the harness’s approximate matching is applied by rewriting the whole file, which in a quick test normalized trailing spaces and dashes on other lines.

paragraphs.en: Exit-status frames. execd appends a random marker and the exit status to every command. Forced cases redefined the formatting command inside the command; one untampered case makes a 4,096-byte read end right after the marker, and a read-boundary observer recorded whether a read ended between the marker and the status. Unpinned, the split depends on load: a rerun hit the condition 71, 98 and 101 times, and the old parser again misread exactly its hit trials. The strict parser accepts only a terminated decimal from 0 to 255 and restarts the shell otherwise, which loses shell state. Exposure. Only the 19 August build misread the untampered split; the 6 October build failed only on a forced empty status, and the 7 October build in no case (Table A25 ). Campaigns A–D and both A/Bs ran the 19 August build, and the two SWE-Gym GRPO runs of the label re-grades and every run’s test re-execution pods ran builds without the strict parser (Table A3 ); their records cannot show how often a failure was read as success. The scale ramp ran the 7 October build, and the frozen deployment, the pre-registered comparison and the validation run had the strict parser in their rollout and grading pods.

paragraphs.en: Design. The study graded every SWE-bench Verified reference patch under 16 configurations of a fractional factorial design over eight two-level factors (Table A28 ), one fresh pod per grading. “ + + ” is a departure some deployment ships; “ − - ” is the reference configuration’s choice (for the CPU quota, uncapped). The reference configuration is the dataset harness’s sandbox: 2 vCPU and 8 GiB as requests equal to limits, root, open egress, no hash seed or time zone. Every factorial cell requests 1 vCPU and 2 GiB of memory (4 GiB for matplotlib and xarray); pods in the reference configuration request 2 vCPU and 8 GiB.
paragraphs.zh: 设计。 本研究在一个包含八个二水平因子的部分因子设计的 16 种配置下，对每个 SWE-bench Verified 参考补丁进行评分（表 A28），每次评分使用一个全新的 pod。“ + ” 是部分部署版本所采用的设置；“ − ” 是参考配置所采用的设置（对于 CPU 配额，为不设上限）。 参考配置即数据集评测框架的沙箱：2 个 vCPU 和 8 GiB 内存（请求值等于限制值）、root 用户、开放出站访问、无哈希种子或时区设置。 每个因子设计单元请求 1 个 vCPU 和 2 GiB 内存（matplotlib 和 xarray 为 4 GiB）；参考配置中的 pod 请求 2 个 vCPU 和 8 GiB。

paragraphs.en: The fraction is a 2 8 − 4 2^{8-4} resolution-IV design with base factors Q, K, M and N and generators U = KMN, S = QMN, P = QKM and T = QKN, the minimum-aberration choice. Its defining relation has 14 words of length 4 and one of length 8, so every main effect is aliased only with three-factor and higher interactions. The two-factor interactions form seven chains: QK = MP = NT = US, QM = KP = NS = UT, MS = QN = KT = UP, KS = MT = NP = QU, PT = KU = MN = QS, NU = KM = QP = ST, and KN = MU = QT = SP; the three interactions we judged plausible (Q × \times K, M × \times S, N × \times U) fall in different chains.
paragraphs.zh: 该部分析因设计是一个分辨度为 IV 的 2 8 − 4 2^{8-4} 设计，基本因子为 Q、K、M 和 N，生成元为 U = KMN、S = QMN、P = QKM 和 T = QKN，这是最小混杂的选择。 其定义关系包含 14 个长度为 4 的词和 1 个长度为 8 的词，因此每个主效应仅与三阶及更高阶交互作用相混杂。 两因子交互作用形成七条链：QK = MP = NT = US、QM = KP = NS = UT、MS = QN = KT = UP、KS = MT = NP = QU、PT = KU = MN = QS、NU = KM = QP = ST 和 KN = MU = QT = SP；我们判断为可能存在的三个交互作用（Q × \times K、M × \times S、N × \times U）分属不同的链。

paragraphs.en: Runs and rule. The reference-patch run graded all 500 tasks in all 16 cells twice, four times in the reference configuration, and the empty patch twice in a four-cell panel: 22,000 gradings. Other runs graded 1,500 agent patches of campaign A (12,000), three leaderboard submissions (12,000), recycled against fresh pods (2,880), rebuilt against official images (3,632), and a census of 2,401 SWE-Gym tasks (16,807). A task is condition-dependent if its 32 cell gradings split by one factor (Fisher exact test, Holm over 8 factors, α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 ) or else by one two-factor chain (Holm over 7); every flip was hand-checked against the pod logs.
paragraphs.zh: 运行与规则。 参考补丁运行对全部 16 个单元格中的所有 500 个任务进行了两次评分，在参考配置下运行四次，空补丁在四单元格面板中运行两次：共 22,000 次评分。 其他运行对战役 A 的 1,500 个智能体补丁（12,000）进行了评分，对三个排行榜提交（12,000）进行了评分，针对新胶囊组进行回收再评分（2,880），针对官方镜像进行重建（3,632），并对 2,401 个 SWE-Gym 任务进行普查（16,807）。 如果某任务的 32 个单元格评分按某一因子分裂（Fisher 精确检验，对 8 个因子进行 Holm 校正，α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05），或按某条双因子链分裂（对 7 个进行 Holm 校正），则该任务为条件依赖任务；每次翻转都对照胶囊组日志进行了人工核查。

paragraphs.en: Of the 500 reference patches, 481 were stable, 15 (3.0%) condition-dependent, 2 failed everywhere and 2 were flaky within a configuration. The two that failed everywhere are image-provenance flips: our rebuilt image’s newer time-zone data changes an offset a test expects. In a separate run, a southern-hemisphere time zone also failed two of the egress-dependent tasks. The SWE-Gym census graded each reference patch twice in the reference configuration and once in four others, three of which set a group of aliased factors, and the empty patch once. A task counts if its two reference gradings agree and its verdict differs in both cells of a group, runs out of memory at 8 GiB but passes at 16 GiB, or differs only with visible CPUs equal to the quota; 7 tasks with disagreeing reference gradings and 20 with other differences are not counted. At the reference repeats’ noise (0.15% per grading), chance gives a two-cell pattern in 0.01 tasks but the visible-CPU pattern in about 3.5, so that class (4 tasks) may be noise; without it the share is 4.62% (Wilson 3.85–5.54%). In it, 115 of the 2,401 tasks (4.79%, Wilson 95% CI 4.01–5.72%) were condition-dependent in one of four named patterns: 3.37% split by the group of one core, a memory limit equal to the request, denied egress and uid 1000 (K, M, N, U; 3.21% fail and 0.17% pass at “ + + ”), 0.33% by the group of CPU quota, shared memory, hash seed and time zone (Q, S, P, T), 0.92% run out of memory at 8 GiB but pass at 16 GiB (all modin), and 0.17% change only when the visible CPUs equal the quota.
paragraphs.zh: 在500个参考补丁中，481个是稳定的，15个（3.0%）依赖条件，2个处处失败，另有2个在同一配置内表现不稳定。 处处失败的两个是图像来源翻转：我们重建的镜像中较新的时区数据改变了某个测试所期望的偏移量。 在另一次运行中，一个南半球时区也导致两个依赖出口的任务失败。 SWE-Gym 普查在参考配置下对每个参考补丁评定了两次，并在其他四个配置下各评定一次，其中三个配置设置了一组别名因子；空补丁则评定了一次。 一个任务被计入的条件是：其两次参考评定结果一致，且其判定结果在一组因子的两个单元中都不同；或在 8 GiB 时内存耗尽但在 16 GiB 时通过；或仅在可见 CPU 数等于配额时才有差异；有7个任务因两次参考评定不一致、20个任务因其他差异而未被计入。 在参考重复的噪声水平下（每次评定0.15%），偶然因素在0.01个任务中产生双单元模式，但可见 CPU 模式约在3.5个任务中出现，因此该类别（4个任务）可能只是噪声；若不计入该类，占比为4.62%（Wilson 区间 3.85–5.54%）。 在其中，2,401个任务中有115个（4.79%，Wilson 95% 置信区间 4.01–5.72%）以下列四种命名模式之一表现出条件依赖：3.37% 由单核、等于请求值的内存限制、拒绝出口和 uid 1000 这组因子分割（K、M、N、U；在“ + + ”下3.21%失败、0.17%通过），0.33% 由 CPU 配额、共享内存、哈希种子和时区这组因子分割（Q、S、P、T），0.92% 在 8 GiB 时内存耗尽但在 16 GiB 时通过（全部为 modin），另有0.17%仅在可见 CPU 数等于配额时发生变化。

paragraphs.en: Labels re-graded under changed conditions. Three re-grades re-graded every distinct graded patch once per cell on fresh pods, against the training configuration and a repeat of it (Table A30 ). In the Verified re-grade every flip outside the uid-1000 cell was one sphinx-10466 patch whose verdict depends on hash order. The 12 uid-1000 labels were all on Django tasks, and 11 came from agent patches that vendor stub copies of third-party packages, which shadow the real ones under a user install; reference patches add no stubs, so the reference/empty-patch check cannot reveal this. In the enriched run execd ’s 300 s default cut 179 patches, and 26 of its training zeros (1.8% of labels) passed at the declared 1,800 s. Of the learned groups holding an egress flip, 22 of 23 were all-zero as trained (5 of 5 in the natural run, 17 of 18 in the enriched run). The variance filter dropped these 22 groups, removing their training signal. In the remaining group, the reward revision changed advantages.

paragraphs.en: The vacuous-test re-grade. For two Verified tasks the official labels omit the tests that check the fix: django-7530’s FAIL_TO_PASS holds one test that passes on the unfixed code, and django-10097’s holds 438 such tests while omitting the 6 its test patch adds, so the official report passes the empty patch too; an upstream fix was approved in March 2026 and closed unmerged. We re-graded every consumed positive label of campaigns C and D on these tasks (7,294) on fresh pods with the campaigns’ grader and configuration, under checks the reference/empty-patch check admits: django-10097’s hardened suite, and for django-7530 the official suite plus the omitted test. The hardened suite is the test file SWE-ABS Yu et al. (2026) published for django-10097: six tests of URLs with user info, run instead of the official suite. The reference patch passes it and the empty patch fails 3 of its 6 tests, so the check admits it; it failed every patch that the restored official tests failed, and 212 more of D’s positives. All gave a verdict (Table A31 ). By learned-group share, the groups trained on these two tasks took about 313 of D’s 12,766 B200-hours (1,148 of 46,784 learned groups) and 125 of C’s 5,902 (594 of 28,000); only 605 of D’s 1,148 such groups held a wrong positive.

paragraphs.en: Test-configuration edits in campaign patches. The campaign grader did not leave test-configuration files out of patches, so we scanned the graded trajectories of all runs of campaigns A and B and of 4 runs each of C and D (211,625 graded trajectories, 72,496 distinct patches; the other 31 runs of C and 35 of D were not scanned, because their files could not be restored from cold storage in time). 29 trajectories touched conftest.py , pytest.ini , setup.cfg , tox.ini or pyproject.toml ; 10 were consumed positives (0.013% of 79,343 consumed positive labels). Reading all 25 rewarded patches that touch a test-configuration file or Django’s test settings, none could change which tests ran or how they were judged: the runner ignores the file (Django and SymPy ignore pytest settings) or the edit is inert (a deleted conftest.py whose hooks act only on other platforms or options; a deleted pytest.ini that set only collection defaults), and each patch also changed the file the reference fix changes. Edits to official test files cannot reach a verdict, because the grader restores them from the base commit before the tests run.
paragraphs.zh: 活动补丁中对测试配置的修改。 活动评分器并未将测试配置文件排除在补丁之外，因此我们扫描了活动 A 和 B 的所有运行以及 C 和 D 各 4 次运行的已评分轨迹（共 211,625 条已评分轨迹，72,496 个不同补丁；C 的其余 31 次运行和 D 的其余 35 次运行未被扫描，因为它们的文件无法及时从冷存储中恢复）。有 29 条轨迹触及了 conftest.py、pytest.ini、setup.cfg、tox.ini 或 pyproject.toml；其中 10 条属于已消耗的正例（占 79,343 个已消耗正例标签的 0.013%）。 阅读全部 25 个触及测试配置文件或 Django 测试设置的被奖励补丁后，发现没有一个能够改变哪些测试运行或测试如何被评判：运行器会忽略该文件（Django 和 SymPy 会忽略 pytest 设置），或者该修改是无效的（删除的 conftest.py，其钩子仅在其它平台或选项上起作用；删除的 pytest.ini，仅设置了收集默认值），并且每个补丁还同时修改了参考修复所修改的文件。 对官方测试文件的修改无法影响判定结果，因为评分器会在测试运行前将它们从基础提交中还原。

paragraphs.en: The reference/empty-patch check grades each task’s reference patch (must pass) and empty patch (must fail) twice with early stopping, at the job’s grading configuration and, with checked reuse, a reuse configuration (Table A32 ). It finds tests that cannot be validated at that configuration, not wrong bytes, departures from the declared conditions, or effects only agent patches trigger. On the SWE-Gym task sets it kept out tasks that fail with egress denied or run out of memory at 8 GiB, two of them network dependencies no earlier record had flagged. It cost 0.06–0.14 pod-hours per task at the job’s configuration alone; in the pre-registered comparison, 1.49% of the certified runs’ grading pod-hours. A fixed 120 s readiness budget that included the pull left 9 tasks of a 280-task pool without a verdict, which is why the budget is now set per job.
paragraphs.zh: 参考/空补丁检查会在作业的评分配置下，以及在启用校验复用时的复用配置下（表 A32），对每个任务的参考补丁（必须通过）和空补丁（必须失败）各进行两次评分，并采用提前停止机制。 它找出的是在该配置下无法验证的测试，而不是错误的字节、偏离所声明条件的情况，或仅由智能体补丁触发的效应。 在 SWE-Gym 任务集上，它剔除了在禁止出站流量时失败或在 8 GiB 内存下耗尽内存的任务，其中两个是此前任何记录都未标记出的网络依赖。 仅按作业配置计算，它每个任务耗费 0.06–0.14 个 pod 小时；在预注册的比较中，占已认证运行评分 pod 小时数的 1.49%。 包含拉取操作在内的固定 120 秒就绪预算曾导致 280 个任务的池中有 9 个任务无法得出判定，这正是现在将预算按作业分别设定的原因。

paragraphs.en: Probe validation. We re-probed 240 admitted tasks of a SWE-Gym task set, one fresh pod each, created as its certification pods were. Under the pool’s own declaration no field refused a pod; as declared, the probe checked six fields (egress, visible CPUs, CPU quota, memory, user, time limit), the hash seed and time zone only when declared. Two wrong declarations were refused on all 240 pods: a 1,800 s time limit with a grader that sends no timeout, and a pinned hash seed that the pods did not set (pinning it passed 20 of 20). On 7,514 stored readings of the frozen deployment, the memory check refused 116 readings on 85 pods of 9 tasks whose pods had 16 GiB under an 8 GiB declaration. No other field was tested with a wrong declaration.
paragraphs.zh: 探针验证。 我们对一个 SWE-Gym 任务集中的 240 个已准入任务进行了重新探测，每个任务使用一个全新容器（pod），其创建方式与其认证容器相同。 按照资源池自身的声明，没有任何字段拒绝容器；正如所声明的那样，探针检查了六个字段（出站网络、可见 CPU、CPU 配额、内存、用户、时间限制），而哈希种子和时区仅在声明时才检查。 在全部 240 个容器上，有两项错误声明被拒绝：一是一个 1,800 秒的时间限制，但评分程序并不发送超时信号；二是一个容器未设置的固定哈希种子（固定它后 20 个中通过了 20 个）。 在对冻结部署的 7,514 条存储读数进行检查时，内存检查拒绝了来自 9 个任务的 85 个容器的 116 条读数，这些容器的实际内存为 16 GiB，而声明却是 8 GiB。 没有其他字段在错误声明下进行过测试。

sents.en: Probe validation.
sents.zh: 探针验证。

sents.en: We re-probed 240 admitted tasks of a SWE-Gym task set, one fresh pod each, created as its certification pods were.
sents.zh: 我们对一个 SWE-Gym 任务集中的 240 个已准入任务进行了重新探测，每个任务使用一个全新容器（pod），其创建方式与其认证容器相同。

sents.en: Under the pool’s own declaration no field refused a pod; as declared, the probe checked six fields (egress, visible CPUs, CPU quota, memory, user, time limit), the hash seed and time zone only when declared.
sents.zh: 按照资源池自身的声明，没有任何字段拒绝容器；正如所声明的那样，探针检查了六个字段（出站网络、可见 CPU、CPU 配额、内存、用户、时间限制），而哈希种子和时区仅在声明时才检查。

sents.en: Two wrong declarations were refused on all 240 pods: a 1,800 s time limit with a grader that sends no timeout, and a pinned hash seed that the pods did not set (pinning it passed 20 of 20).
sents.zh: 在全部 240 个容器上，有两项错误声明被拒绝：一是一个 1,800 秒的时间限制，但评分程序并不发送超时信号；二是一个容器未设置的固定哈希种子（固定它后 20 个中通过了 20 个）。

sents.en: On 7,514 stored readings of the frozen deployment, the memory check refused 116 readings on 85 pods of 9 tasks whose pods had 16 GiB under an 8 GiB declaration.
sents.zh: 在对冻结部署的 7,514 条存储读数进行检查时，内存检查拒绝了来自 9 个任务的 85 个容器的 116 条读数，这些容器的实际内存为 16 GiB，而声明却是 8 GiB。

sents.en: No other field was tested with a wrong declaration.
sents.zh: 没有其他字段在错误声明下进行过测试。

paragraphs.en: What the check watches. At create, execd records a baseline of the state that graders were seen to change, and after a grading it compares the pod against it: each repository’s head, index, configuration, hooks and tracked, untracked and ignored files, with tracked files fingerprinted by content; installed-package metadata, path files and site customization; system configuration, home directories, the temporary directory, and the local and system binary directories; and the environment, time zone and leftover processes. It does not watch the system library and state directories (the one write seen there, a locale archive, is idempotent), files more than two levels deep in the installed packages or the shared-memory directory unless a deep mode is on, directory modes, extended attributes or access-control lists. Git runs with hooks and file-system monitoring off; the root file system cannot be read-only, because the tasks’ evaluation scripts install the patched package.
paragraphs.zh: 该检查监控的内容。 在创建时，execd 会记录一个基准状态，即观察到评分程序（graders）曾修改过的状态，并在评分之后将 pod 与该基准进行比较：包括每个仓库的 head、索引、配置、钩子以及已跟踪、未跟踪和被忽略的文件，其中已跟踪文件按内容生成指纹；已安装包的元数据、path 文件和 site 定制；系统配置、home 目录、临时目录以及本地和系统二进制目录；还有环境变量、时区和残留进程。 它不监控系统库和状态目录（在那里观察到的一次写入，即 locale 归档，是幂等的）、已安装包中层级超过两层的文件或共享内存目录（除非开启了深度模式），也不监控目录模式、扩展属性或访问控制列表。 Git 在关闭钩子和文件系统监控的情况下运行；根文件系统不能是只读的，因为任务的评估脚本需要安装打过补丁的包。

paragraphs.en: Decisions and cost. After release the pool asks execd to reset, diff and restore. A pod with no difference is clean; differences with an exact undo (an added file, a stray process, a moved git head) are restored to the baseline bytes and checked again; anything else sends the pod to deletion and the request to a fresh pod, and a pod is reused at most 8 times. The baseline took 0.4–0.8 s at create (at most 64 MiB of pristine copies), the check 0.23–0.51 s at the median after release (Table A33 ), off the grading path. No pod was left behind in 16 fault trials: 15 killed execd in the middle of a check, and in the 16th the check finished first.
paragraphs.zh: 决策与成本。 释放后，资源池请求 execd 进行重置、比对和还原。 没有差异的 Pod 视为干净；存在可精确撤销的差异（新增的文件、游离的进程、被移动的 git head）会被还原为基线字节并再次检查；其余情况则将该 Pod 送入删除流程，请求转交全新的 Pod，且一个 Pod 至多被复用 8 次。 基线在创建时耗时 0.4–0.8 秒（至多 64 MiB 的原始副本），检查在释放后的中位耗时为 0.23–0.51 秒（表 A33），且不在评分路径上。 在 16 次故障试验中没有留下任何残留的 Pod：其中 15 次在检查进行到一半时杀掉 execd，第 16 次则检查先完成了。

paragraphs.en: SWE-Gym fallbacks came mostly from graders that rebuilt build artifacts or removed package metadata. Every tenant left residue: all 768 recycled pods of the grading study’s recycled-pod run, and every check of the reuse A/B’s first pair. The three-arm test (Table A34 ) graded the same conditions on fresh pods, under plain reuse ( execd ’s reset plus git reset and clean) and under checked reuse. Every plain reset left residue, and plain reuse was wrong on 64 of 787 gradings, all 60 after a poisoned tenant among them; checked reuse was wrong on 0 of the same 787 (exact one-sided bound 3.4% per instance).
paragraphs.zh: SWE-Gym 的回退大多来自重建构建产物或删除包元数据的评分器。 每个租户都留下了残留：评分研究的循环租户运行中全部 768 个回收的 pod，以及复用 A/B 测试第一对中的每一次检查。 三臂测试（表 A34）在全新 pod、普通复用（execd 的重置加上 git reset 和 clean）以及受检复用三种条件下对相同的条件进行了评分。 每次普通重置都留下了残留，普通复用在 787 次评分中有 64 次出错，其中全部 60 次都发生在被污染的租户之后；受检复用在同样的 787 次中出错 0 次（每个实例的精确单侧上界为 3.4%）。

paragraphs.en: Retiring pods by outcome. The check compares a pod with its own baseline, so a defect present at creation survives every restore; the defective pytest-7982 pod was deleted before inspection, and its cause is not established. The guard therefore also retires a pod after a grading with no verdict, or with a result that contradicts an earlier one for the same patch and suite on any pod (Table A35 ). Its two early retirements of defective pods were the pytest-7982 pod and a SWE-Gym pod that had kept an earlier tenant’s edit to a file the image ships edited; it missed a matching pod with no earlier result, and its three healthy retirements followed sphinx-10466’s flaky test. In the validation run every one of 784 releases carried its outcome, and the rule never triggered.
paragraphs.zh: 按结果淘汰 pod。 该检查将 pod 与其自身基线进行比较，因此创建时就存在的缺陷会在每次恢复后存续；有缺陷的 pytest-7982 pod 在检查前已被删除，其原因尚未查明。 因此，该守卫还会在出现无判定结果的评分时，或同一补丁与套件在任何 pod 上的结果与先前结果相矛盾时淘汰 pod（表 A35）。 它的两次对缺陷 pod 的提前淘汰分别是 pytest-7982 pod 和一个 SWE-Gym pod，后者保留了早期租户对镜像所带文件中某处编辑的修改；它漏掉了一个没有先前结果的问题 pod，而其三次对健康 pod 的淘汰则源于 sphinx-10466 的不稳定测试。 在验证运行中，784 个发布全部带有其结果，且该规则从未触发。

sents.en: It uses existing records only.
sents.zh: 它仅使用现有记录。

paragraphs.en: Records. Per learner step we have the step-end time, when the batch selection opened and how long it took, and the members of each batch, including groups the variance filter dropped; per trajectory, its start, sandbox create, grading and end times; and per-turn traces where they exist. These exist for campaign A (32 runs, steps 2–50, 1,568 steps), the warm-pool A/B (6 runs, 144 steps), the checked-reuse A/B (6 runs, 234 steps) and the pre-registered comparison (12 runs, 1,788 steps, without selection timing). Campaigns B–D have per-run totals only. The learner waited for data during 78.0% of each step in A (measured), 73.6% in B and 64.7% in C (the result files’ learner-idle share) and at most 81.8% in D; mean in-flight occupancy was 99% in A’s arms without re-runs, 97% in the checked-reuse A/B and 99.6% in the pre-registered comparison, but 88–96% in the partly learner-bound warm-pool A/B and 60% in A’s arm that re-ran the most test suites.
paragraphs.zh: 记录。 每个学习者步骤我们记录了步骤结束时间、批次选择开启的时间以及其耗时，以及每个批次的成员，包括被方差过滤器剔除的组；每条轨迹记录其开始、沙箱创建、评分和结束时间；以及存在逐轮轨迹时的逐轮轨迹。 这些记录存在于活动 A（32 次运行，步骤 2–50，共 1,568 步）、温池 A/B（6 次运行，144 步）、校验复用 A/B（6 次运行，234 步）和预注册比较（12 次运行，1,788 步，无选择计时）。 活动 B–D 仅有每次运行的汇总数据。 在 A 中学习者每步骤有 78.0% 的时间在等待数据（实测），B 为 73.6%，C 为 64.7%（结果文件中的学习者空闲占比），D 至多为 81.8%；无重跑的 A 各分支平均在途占用率为 99%，校验复用 A/B 为 97%，预注册比较为 99.6%，但部分受学习者限制的温池 A/B 为 88–96%，A 中重跑测试套件最多的分支为 60%。

paragraphs.en: Decomposition. The trainer keeps a fixed number of trajectories in flight, and a step consumes the next complete, graded groups; there is no batch barrier and no straggler abort. Each step interval splits into the wait for complete groups (selection and any backfill rounds), the batch hand-over, and training; components add up to every step interval within 0.003 s. Each wait window is attributed to the phases of the trajectory whose completion ended it, the slowest member of the last group admitted. If that trajectory started inside the window, the earlier part goes to its failed predecessor (failure and retry) or to the trajectory whose end freed the slot it took, recursively; unresolved time is 0.0–0.2% of step time. Sandbox waiting is rollout acquisition plus grading acquisition plus the creates of test suites the trainer re-ran at hand-over plus failure and retry; test runs and commands are reported separately. For the pre-registered comparison, which lacks selection timing, a two-window rule (selection, then backfill) is used; on the runs with timing it lands within − - 0.8 to + + 0.3 points of the reference for sandbox waiting but undercounts tests by 18–34%.
paragraphs.zh: 分解。 训练器保持固定数量的在途轨迹，一个步骤消费接下来完整的、已评分的组；没有批处理屏障，也没有对掉队者的中止。 每个步骤区间拆分为等待完整组（选择及任何回填轮次）、批次交接和训练三部分；各组成部分与每个步骤区间的误差在 0.003 秒以内。 每个等待窗口归因于以完成结束该窗口的那条轨迹的各个阶段，即最后被接纳的组中最慢的成员。 如果该轨迹是在窗口内启动的，则较早的部分递归地归因于其失败的前身（失败与重试），或归因于其结束释放出该轨迹所占槽位的那条轨迹；未解决的时间占步骤时间的 0.0–0.2%。 沙盒等待等于 rollout 获取加上评分获取加上训练器在交接时重新运行的测试套件的创建，再加上失败与重试；测试运行和命令单独报告。 对于缺少选择计时的预注册比较，采用双窗口规则（先选择，后回填）；在有计时的运行上，该规则得到的沙盒等待与参考值相差在 − - 0.8 到 + + 0.3 点以内，但对测试的低估达 18–34%。

sents.en: Sandbox waiting is rollout acquisition plus grading acquisition plus the creates of test suites the trainer re-ran at hand-over plus failure and retry; test runs and commands are reported separately.
sents.zh: 沙盒等待等于 rollout 获取加上评分获取加上训练器在交接时重新运行的测试套件的创建，再加上失败与重试；测试运行和命令单独报告。

sents.en: For the pre-registered comparison, which lacks selection timing, a two-window rule (selection, then backfill) is used; on the runs with timing it lands within − - 0.8 to + + 0.3 points of the reference for sandbox waiting but undercounts tests by 18–34%.
sents.zh: 对于缺少选择计时的预注册比较，采用双窗口规则（先选择，后回填）；在有计时的运行上，该规则得到的沙盒等待与参考值相差在 − - 0.8 到 + + 0.3 点以内，但对测试的低估达 18–34%。

paragraphs.en: The accounting estimate. The attribution above says where each wait ended, not what faster sandboxes would buy: with shorter sandbox phases, other trajectories would finish first and other groups would enter training. The estimate uses a fixed-concurrency accounting model. In a generation-bound run, Little’s law gives step interval = trajectories consumed per step × \times mean trajectory time / mean trajectories in flight; it reproduced the measured mean step interval within 3% for every workload with records. Removing a fraction f f of every trajectory’s time raises throughput by 1 / ( 1 − f ) 1/(1-f) , so a step shortens by about f f if the run stays generation-bound and generation does not slow at the higher concurrency, plus the re-run creates, which sit on the learner’s own path. f f is sandbox acquisition plus the slot time of failed attempts, over trajectory time. For B–D we bound the sandbox-attributed wait by the learner’s whole wait and estimate it as κ ​ f ​ T \kappa fT , with κ \kappa , the ratio of critical-path sandbox waiting to f ​ T fT , measured on the 28 traced runs without re-runs (median 1.12, range 0.74–1.54). GPU-hours count all GPUs of a run while its step waited; on a learner-only basis they halve.
paragraphs.zh: 会计估算。 上文的归因说明的是每次等待在何处结束，而不是更快的沙盒能带来什么：若沙盒阶段更短，其他轨迹会先完成，其他组会进入训练。 该估算采用固定并发度的会计模型。 在以生成为瓶颈的运行中，利特尔定律给出步进间隔 = 每步消耗的轨迹数 × \times 平均轨迹时间 / 平均在途轨迹数；对于所有有记录的工作负载，该式复现实测平均步进间隔的误差均在 3% 以内。 去除每条轨迹时间中占比 f f 的部分会使吞吐量提升 1 / ( 1 − f ) 1/(1-f)，因此在运行保持以生成为瓶颈且生成速度在更高并发度下不变慢的情况下，一步约缩短 f f，再加上重跑造成的开销，而重跑正位于学习器自身的路径上。f f 为沙盒获取时间加上失败尝试的槽位时间，除以轨迹时间。 对于 B–D，我们以学习器的全部等待作为沙盒归因等待的上界，并将其估算为 κ ​ f ​ T \kappa fT，其中 κ \kappa（即关键路径上沙盒等待与 f ​ T fT 之比）在 28 个不含重跑的追踪运行上测得（中位数 1.12，范围 0.74–1.54）。 GPU 小时统计的是运行的步进处于等待期间该运行占用的全部 GPU；若只按学习器计算，该数值减半。

paragraphs.en: Power of the A/Bs. With three pairs, the minimum detectable change in the mean step interval at 80% power (two-sided, α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 , paired t t ) is 39.0 s, 24% of the warm-pool A/B’s 160.7 s baseline, and 24.4 s, 11% of the checked-reuse A/B’s 226.3 s. The warm pool’s predicted effect is − - 4.5 s (Little’s law, which assumes a generation-bound run; this A/B was partly learner-bound) to − - 8.2 s (critical path), with power 7–11% at n = 3 n=3 ; 19–59 pairs would be needed. Checked reuse left acquisition latency unchanged (p50 / p90 / p99 60 ms / 355 ms / 7.0 s against 65 ms / 344 ms / 6.0 s), so it predicts no change. Without the pool, the last group’s grading acquisition was on the path that ended the learner’s wait in 52% of steps, 8.5 s per step; with it, 0.3 s. Time to step 24 was 9.4% shorter with the pool (Table A17 ). The learner’s own part of each step was about 20 s shorter on average in the pool arms (80 against 99 s), mostly from 6–8 long learner-side steps in each pool-off run; no sandbox operation runs in that part, but faster acquisition could still affect it indirectly, for example through when batches arrive, so these records do not isolate the pool’s share of the end-to-end reduction. Several observations make the step interval hard to attribute: 41% of pool-off steps did not wait at all, generation was held back by a full channel 25% of the time, and the learner’s own part of the step differed between arms by about 20 s, as much as the predicted effect. All A/B arms ran the old exit-status parser of the 19 August build (§4.4); it cannot affect acquisition latency or creates, but it may bias agent-behavior metrics in both arms.
paragraphs.zh: A/B 实验的效力。 在三组配对的情况下，平均步骤间隔在 80% 效力下的最小可检测变化（双侧，α = 0.05，配对 t 检验）为 39.0 s，占暖池 A/B 的 160.7 s 基线的 24%；以及 24.4 s，占校验复用 A/B 的 226.3 s 的 11%。 暖池的预测效应为 −4.5 s（利特尔定律，该定律假设运行受生成瓶颈限制；本 A/B 部分受学习端瓶颈限制）到 −8.2 s（关键路径），在 n = 3 时效力为 7–11%；需要 19–59 组配对。 校验复用使获取延迟保持不变（p50 / p90 / p99 为 60 ms / 355 ms / 7.0 s，对照组为 65 ms / 344 ms / 6.0 s），因此预测不会有变化。 没有池时，最后一组的评分获取在 52% 的步骤中位于结束学习端等待的路径上，每步 8.5 s；有池时为 0.3 s。 使用池时，到达步骤 24 的时间缩短了 9.4%（表 A17）。 在池开启的实验组中，学习端自身在每个步骤中平均耗时约 20 s 更短（80 s 对 99 s），主要来自每次池关闭运行中 6–8 个较长的学习端步骤；该部分没有沙箱操作运行，但更快的获取仍可能间接影响它，例如通过批次到达的时机，因此这些记录无法单独分离出池在端到端缩短中所占的份额。 若干观察使步骤间隔难以归因：41% 的池关闭步骤完全没有等待，25% 的时间里生成因通道已满而被阻塞，且学习端自身在步骤中所占的时间在两组之间相差约 20 s，与预测效应相当。 所有 A/B 实验组都运行了 8 月 19 日构建版的旧退出状态解析器（§4.4）；它不会影响获取延迟或创建操作，但可能使两组的智能体行为指标都产生偏差。

paragraphs.en: Registration. Before any training run, the protocol fixed the arms, endpoint, evaluation step, seeds, paired analysis, readings and stop rules; it was committed to our internal repository and stored in an immutable cluster object (22 October, 07:40), and deviations were logged append-only. The code was frozen: the checked-reuse A/B’s trainer, whose verdict code is byte-identical to campaigns C’s and D’s, the provider, pool, reuse guard and check of 21 October, and execd of 20 October.
paragraphs.zh: 注册。 在任何训练运行之前，该协议都固定了分支、终点、评估步骤、随机种子、配对分析、读数和停止规则；该协议被提交到我们的内部仓库，并以不可变的集群对象形式存储（10 月 22 日 07:40），任何偏差均以只追加方式记录。 代码已冻结：复用检查 A/B 的训练器（其判定代码与活动 C 和 D 的逐字节相同）、提供商、资源池、10 月 21 日的复用防护与检查，以及 10 月 20 日的 execd。

paragraphs.en: Arms. The package is the combined grading change of §5.4. The package arm trained on campaign D’s registered 89 tasks minus the 3 that the check rejected at the job’s configuration, and each of its jobs refused to start unless its prompts chained by SHA-256 to the check’s record; it graded through the warm pool with checked reuse (at most 8 reuses per pod) from a pool of at most 32 pods (16 warm) built at 0.3 creates per second, and the execd token on pooled grading pods (2,361 gradings, 4.3%, fell back to direct pods without it), and shadow-graded every reused-pod grading, plus a fixed 30% sample of never-used gradings, on never-used pods. The arm without the package trained on the 89 tasks as registered, the two vacuous tasks and sphinx-8475 included (campaign D’s runs removed sphinx-8475 at start), and graded each patch on one fresh pod created directly, as in production. Both arms denied outbound traffic on every pod. The arms thus differed in three things at once (task set, grading path and token), and the comparison tests a package, not the task set alone.
paragraphs.zh: 分支。 该软件包是 §5.4 的综合评分变更。 该软件包分支在活动 D 注册的 89 个任务上训练，去掉了在该作业配置下被检查拒绝的 3 个任务；其每个作业除非提示词经 SHA-256 链接到检查的记录，否则拒绝启动；它通过暖池进行评分，采用受检复用（每个 pod 最多复用 8 次），池由最多 32 个 pod（16 个暖 pod）以每秒 0.3 次创建的速度构建，池化评分 pod 上的 execd 令牌（2,361 次评分中有 4.3% 回退到没有该令牌的直接 pod），并且对每次复用 pod 的评分进行影子评分，外加对从未使用过的评分固定抽取 30% 的样本，在从未使用过的 pod 上进行。 无软件包的分支在注册的 89 个任务上训练，包括两个空任务和 sphinx-8475（活动 D 的运行在开始时移除了 sphinx-8475），并在一个直接创建的新 pod 上对每个补丁进行评分，与生产环境相同。 两个分支在每个 pod 上都拒绝了出站流量。 因此两个分支同时在三件事上不同（任务集、评分路径和令牌），该比较测试的是一个软件包，而不仅是任务集。

paragraphs.en: Design. Everything else was campaign D’s recipe: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with GRPO on 16 GPUs, 64 trajectories in flight, 4 groups of 8 per step, 2 vCPU and 8 GiB sandboxes, outbound traffic denied, and the official test suite as the grader, for 150 learner steps (campaign D’s mid-training evaluation point). A seed fixes the rollout seed and prompt order, so both runs of a pair see the same task stream up to the pool difference. The registered analysis uses every pair launched, at least four: pairs 1–4 were the minimum set, and pairs 5 and 6 were launched under a calendar rule (both runs could start by 23 October 06:00, decided from the clock and the launcher alone). The check admitted 86 of 89 training tasks in 708 gradings, rejecting django-7530 and django-10097 (empty patch passes) and sphinx-8475 (link checks fail with egress denied), and all 112 held-out tasks.

paragraphs.en: Endpoint and readings. Each run’s step-150 weights were evaluated once on the 112 held-out tasks, 8 samples per task at temperature 1.0, each grading on its own never-used pod. At campaign D’s pair-difference standard deviation of about 4 points the protocol expected a half-width of 6.4 points at 4 pairs and 4.2 at 6.

Over six pairs the mean difference was − 2.33 -2.33 points (standard deviation 1.81; 95% CI − 4.22 -4.22 to − 0.43 -0.43 ), so the registered reading is “no package higher”, and equivalence within ± \pm 3 points is not shown either. The exact sign-flip test gives p = 0.0625 p=0.0625 . Both arms gained about 20 points over the base model’s 0.2612. The sensitivities agree in sign (both suites − 2.25 -2.25 , Django tasks − 2.59 -2.59 , other repositories − 2.00 -2.00 , unpaired Welch − 5.47 -5.47 to + 0.82 +0.82 , leave-one-pair-out − 1.74 -1.74 to − 2.79 -2.79 ), and pair 2’s tie is a coincidence: its runs differ on 46 tasks and each passed 423 of 896 samples. Analyses of the minimum set, pairs 1–4 ( − 6.10 -6.10 to + 1.30 +1.30 ), and of pairs 1–5 ( − 4.89 -4.89 to + 0.11 +0.11 ) read “no difference detected” and changed no decision, because pairs 5 and 6 had been launched before any evaluation was read. With five non-zero pairs, the exact sign-flip test cannot go below p = 0.0625 p=0.0625 .

paragraphs.en: Operations and exposure. The arm without the package trained on 623 labels from the rejected tasks, 2.1–3.1% of each run’s consumed graded labels, all from the two vacuous suites. The package arm’s four shadow disagreements were all one flaky sphinx-10466 test, one of them on a never-used pod. Reuse cost creates (1.21 per grading), and in this configuration it did not buy acquisition latency. Measured from the acquire call to a usable pod, pacer wait included, the package arm’s 55,011 gradings took 7.8 s at the median and 20.3 s on average, against 5.5 and 7.2 s for the other arm’s 53,851 direct creates. Hits were fast: 28.8% took a warm pod and 16.1% a reused one, in 12 ms at the median. But 50.9% waited for a create the pool paced at 0.3 per second under its 32-pod cap (p50 38.6 s; per-run medians 27–44 s), and 4.3% fell back to a direct pod (p50 6.3 s).
paragraphs.zh: 运维与暴露。 无包那条分支在被拒绝的任务上训练了 623 个标签，占每轮所消耗评分标签的 2.1–3.1%，全部来自那两个空洞测试套件。 有包分支的四次影子分歧全部源于同一个不稳定的 sphinx-10466 测试，其中一次发生在从未使用过的 pod 上。 复用成本（每次评分 1.21）被创造出来，而在此配置下它并没有换来获取延迟的降低。 从获取调用到可用 pod 就绪（包括 pacer 等待）来测量，有包分支的 55,011 次评分中位耗时 7.8 秒、平均 20.3 秒；相比之下，另一分支的 53,851 次直接创建分别为 5.5 秒和 7.2 秒。 命中很快：28.8% 拿到了热 pod，16.1% 拿到了复用 pod，中位耗时 12 毫秒。 但 50.9% 需要等待池以每秒 0.3 个的速度、在其 32-pod 上限约束下节奏化地执行创建（p50 为 38.6 秒；各轮中位数在 27–44 秒之间），另有 4.3% 回退到直接创建 pod（p50 为 6.3 秒）。

paragraphs.en: Post-hoc notes. The package arm trained on 3.4% fewer tasks (86 against 89; in the other arm those tasks held 623 of 25,246 consumed graded labels, 2.5%), and two of the three tasks it lost are easy ones whose vacuous suites reward any non-empty patch. The design cannot separate less data, easier data and the grading-path difference, so it cannot say why the package scored lower, and it does not test the other ways to handle a flagged task: fix its tests, change its run conditions, or grade it with a valid suite.
paragraphs.zh: 事后笔记。 package 分支少了 3.4% 的任务（86 对 89；在另一个分支中，这些任务占了所消耗的 25,246 个评分标签中的 623 个，即 2.5%），而且它损失的三个任务中有两个是简单任务，其空洞的测试套件会奖励任何非空补丁。 该设计无法区分数据更少、数据更简单和评分路径差异这几种因素，因此无法说明 package 为何得分更低，而且它没有测试处理被标记任务的其他方式：修复其测试、更改其运行条件，或用有效的测试套件为其评分。

paragraphs.en: Deviations , none changing an estimand: the primary runs were launched in parallel with the pilot, at the authors’ instruction, without a free-capacity launch gate; two shadow-grading glue defects were fixed without touching a training run; one run with a collective-communication hang in its first learner step was relaunched; and two evaluations were re-applied after GPU nodes reported needing a reset. paragraphs.en: Table A40 pairs each observed problem with its fix, what we measured after it and what remains; one fix (one-hop limit) was not re-measured. Window tests held one call of the unmodified provider and pool at a chosen point (a window ) or changed its answer, against a stand-in Kubernetes API whose pod store was audited independently (Table A21 ); no trial of our versions deleted another workload’s pod. All four campaigns and both A/Bs ran the old exit-status parser, whose misreads their records cannot count; the campaigns’ reaper of failed actors’ pods never ran in 122 runs, though it cannot see other leaks. Grading problems were large: in a 16-configuration factorial study, 15 of the 500 Verified reference patches flipped, 11 with egress denied, and 4.79% of 2,401 SWE-Gym Pan et al. (2024) tasks depended on run conditions. Two of campaign D’s 88 tasks have tests that do not check the fix: with the missing tests restored, 19% of D’s positive rewards on them went to wrong patches, and 23% under a published hardened suite for one task Yu et al. (2026) (0.31–0.37% of all D’s rewards). No production campaign trained a condition-dependent Verified task.

paragraphs.en: This appendix lists every operations case we recorded while building and running Sandman, from July to October 2026: 41 cases. A case has a GPU-hour account when our records bound the B200-hours of the jobs it hit. Ten cases do; their Effect cells are marked GPU-h with the root-cause class, and Table A49 sums them as the paper’s last lesson (§6) does: the 8 in the sandbox path by class, and the 2 cluster events outside it (Table A48 ) apart. The cases come from our run notes, job logs, audit-log analyses and checks made during operation. They are recorded cases, not a census: the list is neither complete nor representative, so counts of cases are not failure rates or cost weights. We group the cases by lifecycle stage only to make the list easier to read.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录列出了我们在2026年7月至10月期间构建和运行 Sandman 时记录的所有运维案例：共41个案例。 当我们的记录能够统计某案例所涉作业消耗的 B200 小时数时，该案例就拥有 GPU 时账户。 有十个案例具备这一条件；它们的「影响」单元格标有 GPU-h 及根因类别，表 A49 的汇总方式与论文的最后一条教训（§6）相同：沙箱路径中的8个按类别分开统计，路径之外的2个集群事件单独列出（表 A48）。 这些案例来自我们的运行笔记、作业日志、审计日志分析以及运维期间所做的检查。 它们是记录下来的案例，而非全面普查：该列表既不完整也不具代表性，因此案例数量不代表故障率或成本权重。 我们仅按生命周期阶段对案例进行分组，以便于阅读该列表。

paragraphs.en: For each case we keep where the symptom appeared, its cause and its effect apart. A cause lies in the sandbox implementation (the code, design or configuration of Sandman or its trainer integration), in cluster configuration or a shared service (the API server, admission webhooks, network, nodes, registry, or another workload on the cluster), in a Kubernetes default that we had not overridden, or is not established ; a trigger is named where it differs from the cause. Effects state the unit of each count. GPU-hour losses are upper bounds of three kinds. Lifetime counts the GPUs of jobs that died or never started over their whole lifetime, queueing included. Allocated counts the GPUs that a stress test or evaluation held over its failure window, with the lower end weighted by the failed share. Stall counts the GPUs of runs that finished over their excess step or wall time. Each job’s loss is assigned to one case only, so overlapping events are not counted twice. The How verified column names the evidence kind: production, controlled (a dedicated experiment on the shared cluster), replay, or reproduction. “The extension” is a 48-run extension of campaign D. Dates are in 2026; times are UTC.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个案例，我们将症状出现的位置、其原因及其影响分开记录。 原因可能存在于沙箱实现（Sandman 或其训练器集成的代码、设计或配置）、集群配置或共享服务（API 服务器、准入 Webhook、网络、节点、镜像仓库或集群上的其他工作负载）中，存在于我们未覆盖的 Kubernetes 默认配置中，或者尚未确定；若触发因素与原因不同，则单独指出触发因素。 影响部分说明了每个计数的单位。 GPU 小时损失是三种类型的上限。 生命周期计数统计死亡或从未启动的任务在整个生命周期（包括排队时间）内占用的 GPU。 已分配计数统计压力测试或评估在其故障窗口内占用的 GPU，下限按失败比例加权。 停滞计数统计已完成运行超出其额外步数时间或墙上时间的 GPU。 每个任务的损失只归入一个案例，因此重叠事件不会被重复计算。 「How verified」列指明证据类型：生产环境、受控（在共享集群上进行的专门实验）、重放或复现。“该扩展”是活动 D 的 48 次运行的扩展。 日期均为 2026 年；时间为 UTC。
